chapters.title: Chapter 101: The Search
paragraphs: The night before, Russell worked quietly with the others to bury the three corpses.

They no longer had the Special Furnace in the shelter, so there was no need to use the bodies as fuel. Instead, the survivors dug shallow graves beyond the damaged wall, marking each with a simple stone.
Russell knew the dead well.
All three had once served as scouts, but they sustained injuries while fleeing from Sentinels. Those injuries had forced them to take on odd jobs inside the shelter instead.
Seeing their lifeless bodies laid to rest stirred something heavy in his chest.
"Haa~" Russel sighed as he looked at them.
He wasn’t new to death. The A.I. apocalypse had hardened him long ago, but familiarity never dulled the pain he felt.
For some time, he stood silently as the dirt was shoveled over them.
By dawn, Kai already accepted the fact that the mutated humans who had attacked them weren’t part of the Global Hunt event.
Unfortunately, they had no idea where they came from or what their purpose was.
For now, he set the matter aside since even Hale didn’t speak about them. Kai just gathered the six remaining scouts to give them their mission.
Supplies were laid out in neat rows... They were smoke grenades, ammunition for their revolvers, flashlights, bandages, hatchets, granola bars, water bottles, and radios for communication.
Each man and woman packed their share into small, rugged backpacks.
"These items are all for you..." Kai said.
He had divided them into two groups... Russell’s team and Augustine’s team.
Russell would lead Gabby and Dylan, while Augustine took the other two...
Russell’s team had known each other for years, long before Kai and the others had taken over Haven‐45 Shelter.
They had scavenged together, fought together, and survived together.
In short, their bond was forged in hardship, and it showed in the way they moved together.
As soon as Kai informed them of the details he learned about the Gene Traders and gave them instructions, they quickly acted efficiently.
"This should be good enough." Russel muttered as he decided to wear his scouting gear.
Gabby and Dylan followed suit and wore their most comfortable gear instead.
Indeed, unlike the camouflage suits Kai had provided, the three weren’t wearing the new gear he had given.
Instead, they stuck to their old scavenger outfits that were ragged and dirty but heavily modified to their liking.

Russell wore patched cargo pants with strips of leather, a faded jacket with metal plating sewn over the chest to protect his heart, and a pair of goggles that had saved his eyes more times than he could count.
Gabby’s outfit was similar, though she had added rope loops across her belt and a small pouch for tools. Ropes were useful for climbing or hauling debris after all.
Dylan, on the other hand, also carried an additional satchel with its straps lined with scrap metal to keep blades from cutting through...
Of course, knives were strapped to their thighs, and makeshift padding covered their forearms. Furthermore, since Dylan was stronger, his backpack was also larger, filled with various supplies.
These weren’t polished uniforms, but they were certainly practical, born of necessity from years of scouting the land.
"I wish you all success," Kai said as the two teams moved.
At the gate, before stepping into the wilderness, Russell and Augustine paused to coordinate.
Russell adjusted his goggles and spoke first. "We’ll head east, toward the collapsed industrial zone. Plenty of ruins there, and if that Augmented Human was right, the Trader might be hiding there.
Augustine nodded as he also considered this location.
"Then we’ll take the western side, near the old highway. I think that we’d find a Tyrant there at the very least. I’m thinking of searching the forest too... Either way, we’ll cover more ground."
Russell gave a short grunt of approval.
"Good. Keep your radio clear unless it’s urgent."
"Same to you," Augustine replied.
With that, the two leaders turned to their teams. Six figures stepped out of the shelter together, splitting into two directions once they reached the outside.
Kai watched them confidently before he looked at Atom behind him...
Needless to say, he was also planning to go out to search for the Gene Trader.
"Let’s see who finds him first." Kai said as he decided to go north instead.
Hours into their search within the abandoned industrial zone, Russell crouched down, with his goggles lowered over his eyes.
After checking the ground, he knew that the dirt showed clear signs of something heavy moving through... There were deep, uneven impressions that matched the stride of a Field Tyrant.
The ground was torn up, with patches of scorched earth where plasma fire had hit. There could have been a battle around here.
"Looks like it moved through here," Russell muttered, brushing dust from the grooves.
Gabby knelt beside him and nodded.
"Engaged in battle, maybe. See the scorch marks?" She pointed to blackened patches where plasma fire had scarred the ground.
Dylan adjusted his satchel and scanned the area. "Could be Hale again. Or another group. Either way, it’s not our concern."

Russell nodded. The Tyrant’s trail was clear, but their mission wasn’t mainly to chase machines. Their main task was to search for the Gene Trader, the elusive figure that Kai and the others must meet...
"Alright... Let’s leave it at that," Russell said firmly. "We’re not here to fight another Tyrant..."
The three moved on, ignoring the battlefield remnants.
As they moved through the industrial zone, they passed collapsed structures, broken walls, and the frames of old vehicles.
The ruins were silent, and because of the buildings around, there were many shady areas. It was the kind of place Hale had described... untouched by sunlight.
"The Gene Trader might be here..." Russel muttered.
Soon, Russell’s goggles caught faint glimmers in the distance, probably reflections from shattered glass.
He raised a hand, signaling the others to slow. Gabby tightened her grip on her revolver, and Dylan did the same.
They moved carefully as they scouted the area...
Then Russell froze.
On the far side of the ruined factory floor, half‐hidden in shadow, a figure stood motionless.
It wasn’t a Sentinel or a Spyder.
The figure wore a dark cloak, and the way it lingered in the darkness made Russell’s chest tighten.
Gabby whispered, "Do you see that?"

chapters.title: Chapter 102: Noticed by the Enemy
paragraphs: About an hour ago, Kai and Atom had also begun their search for the Gene Trader.
They moved steadily north, leaving Haven‐45 Shelter behind.
Atom, the Sentinel, walked at Kai’s side so it could easily protect him if necessary.
The first stretch was open ground. There were rusted vehicle frames lying half-buried in the soil, stripped long ago by scavengers.
Kai stopped at each wreck, checking for footprints or discarded supplies or any other traces of people, but found nothing.
During this time, Atom just followed silently with its sensors scanning the area as it waited for orders.
After half an hour, the terrain shifted. They reached the outskirts of what had once been a small settlement.
The buildings weren’t intact anymore.
Most were collapsed houses, their walls were scorched, and roofs caved in.
"This..." Kai was then surprised to see missile craters that were everywhere in the streets. Needless to say, the pavement had also been shattered, showing where explosions had torn through.
Then Kai noticed bullet holes riddling large sections of the walls.
A few minutes later, he came across a long, scorched line carved into the road. It was the unmistakable mark of laser fire cutting across the surface.
Everywhere they looked, the signs were clear... This place hadn’t been abandoned peacefully. It had been destroyed.
Kai stepped through the remains of a workshop, kicking aside broken tools and shattered glass. There were no tracks or signs of life at all.
"Gene Trader... Where are you?~" Kai muttered as if the Trader would show up if he started calling for him.
In any case, they moved deeper, passing a row of ruined storefronts. The signs were faded, letters barely visible.
Inside, shelves were overturned, and they were all stripped bare. Kai crouched, brushing dust from the floor.
There were no footprints or any trail... It means that there was no need to further explore the building since the Gene Trader should not be here.

Another thirty minutes passed as they searched. They checked a burned-out gas station, a collapsed warehouse, and even the frame or husk of an old bus left on the roadside. Each stop turned up nothing but silence...
The frustration built in Kai’s chest. He had hoped for at least a clue, but this place was actually very desolate. There weren’t even any enemies or Mechanical Soldier lurking around!
"Ahh... Is that—"
Kai suddenly noticed smoke. A dark column of smoke rose in the distance, and it was thicker than cooking fires and too heavy to be anything but destruction.
Kai knew that there was a huge battle going on right now!
"Let’s move," he muttered.
They then moved forward until the smoke came into view.
A shelter that was probably previously a prison stood in the distance...
At this point, its walls were badly damaged and only patched with scrap metal and sandbags. But it was under siege.
A Field Tyrant, towering six meters tall, was pummeling a few survivors in front!
Its massive limbs smashed barricades, each strike shaking the ground.
What was even more terrifying was the flamethrowers mounted on its shoulders that could burn through their fortifications...
Whoosh~
Then the flamethrowers roared.
Twin nozzles mounted on its arms spewed torrents of fire, washing over the barricades and igniting everything in their path.
Sandbags burst into flame, wooden supports collapsed, and the defenders inside scrambled to avoid the inferno.

Kai knew that this would be very difficult to survive unless that shelter had several Survivors with high-grade combat talent... or perhaps, they had a trump card like Atom that could fight against it.
Soon, he heard survivors shouting from behind the walls, firing desperately through gaps, but their bullets sparked uselessly against the Tyrant’s armor.
Some were even using bows and arrows, but the machine just advanced step by step with its flames sweeping across the fortifications, reducing them to ash.
Just like that, the surroundings were filled with charred debris that littered the ground.
The shelter wasn’t just being attacked, it was being burned alive!
Kai crouched as he studied the battlefield. He had fought two Tyrants already, but this was the first time he’d seen a mounted flamethrower...
He then glanced at Atom.
The Sentinel noticed this, but it was just motionless, waiting for orders.
Kai wryly smiled as he turned his attention back to the battlefield.
"We spent an hour without getting good news. I guess this is the sign to help them."
Well, he was also thinking that this shelter might have information about the Gene Trader. So it might be better to get involved.
Boom!
Suddenly, the Tyrant unleashed another blast of fire, sweeping across the barricades.
A section of the wall collapsed inward as the hot flames started consuming the supports. After a few moments, survivors scrambled out while coughing through the smoke.
Then, it was at this point that two survivors burst from the shelter’s ruined entrance and each of them was wielding a heavy sword.
Their armor was mismatched, but that didn’t matter at all! They moved like some sort of Heavy Knights!
One charged straight at the Tyrant, swinging his sword against its armored leg.
Bang!
Sparks flew as steel scraped metal, forcing the machine to shift its stance.
The other survivor dodged to the side while slashing at exposed joints of the Tyrant, before rolling out as the flamethrower spewed fire!
It looked inelegant moving like that, but they both dented the Field Tyrant. It was not enough, but they had done something.
The Tyrant retaliated, sweeping its massive arm to knock them back, but the pair didn’t back down!
Their blades struck again and again, not enough to pierce the plating, but enough to slow its advance and draw its attention away from the shelter!
Kai crouched lower, watching their desperate stand.
He knew they couldn’t hold out for long, but their courage bought precious seconds.
Then, he glanced at Atom standing ready beside him, waiting for his command.
"Not yet..." He muttered.
Then, Kai’s radio suddenly came alive with its static breaking through the silence.
Russell’s voice came through urgently, "Kai! We found him. The Gene Trader... he’s here!"

"Nice..." He was relieved that they finally found the Gene Trader... But before he could properly respond and ask about the whereabouts, the radio’s noise had actually been carried across the battlefield.
Because of that, they were noticed by the Field Tyrant!

chapters.title: Chapter 103: The Destruction of the Shelter
paragraphs: Haven‐62 seemed peaceful, but they were in a dire situation.

It hadn’t been that long when the Mech Siege had nearly torn the shelter apart. The previous leaders had died in the fighting, and with them went the last of Haven‐62’s high‐level Augmented Humans. What remained was a battered community of thirty-two survivors, crumbling walls, and the faint hope of not being targeted by the A.I. Army.
Farrah rose early each day during the 10-day wait for the Global Event...
Her job here was to patrol a certain sector for a few hours every day. Specifically, the garden, the pens, and the well.
Although the shelter still had food supplies, it was not much. They had a small garden in the courtyard, and even though its soil had blackened, it was fertile enough to yield vegetables.
It must be protected at all times.
Aside from that, she’d always check the goats in their pens, since they were providing milk for everyone...
Lastly, the well in the center gave them clean water... This was their lifeline, and they must ensure that it would not be polluted at all costs.
"Has it been a day?" Farrah muttered as she clutched her stomach... With her Survivor Title, her satiety wasn’t easily decreased, but she still had to eat once a day to survive.
[ Title Effect: Satiety decreases more slowly. Survivors can endure longer without food before hunger penalties occur. ]
Anyway, the last meal she had was an MRE.

She recalled that only three boxes remained, and they were even from the fallen leaders’ vault. For thirty‐two people, it was barely anything. Even rationed to one meal a day, the supplies would vanish quickly.

Thankfully, with their Title and Gene Enhancements, it allowed most of them to survive on less. Nonetheless, it felt like they were just trying to survive because of it... They didn’t feel energetic or even capable of fighting long battles.
Farrah often thought about that as she watched the new leaders. They needed some improvement or changes... Unfortunately, she really had no say in this shelter.
The leaders were the oldest among the survivors, chosen by necessity rather than skill.
Their voices carried authority, but they would sometimes make bad decisions...
Well, they weren’t Foreign Survivors like her and Alfie.
They hadn’t been pulled from Earth, dropped into this world with strange talents and the burden of adapting.
For them, Farrah and Alfie were outsiders. They were only within the top 10 strongest fighters in Haven‐62...
Indeed, among the thirty-two, there were another eight who could stand against the machines.
"This shelter has no future..." Farrah muttered to herself as she swung her sword for practice...
Farrah’s Spirit Knight talent gave her a bond with her blade. It strengthened her strikes, and it allowed her to obtain Gene Skills that could empower her Talent as a Spirit Knight.
"Ssshhh... Don’t say that. That old man might hear you..." Alfie said.

Alfie’s Gladiator talent made him really good in combat, his endurance and raw power could even be compared to their strongest fighter right now. Still, because he lacked Spirit Points, he could barely use his Gene Skills.
Nonetheless, each day, they trained together in the courtyard.
They sparred until sweat soaked their clothes, until their muscles burned, until they reminded themselves that they were still alive and could always get stronger.
Well, they had to work hard since they weren’t even fighters back on Earth...
"Ah! Farrah, that’s..." Alfie said as he worried look at the shelter’s gate.
This happened during one of those sparring sessions... Apparently, their base had been found by the Tyrant!
The alarms rang out...
From the horizon, the machines advanced... There were Sentinels, Spyder units, and towering above them, a Field Tyrant armed with flamethrowers.
The survivors scrambled to defend the shelter... About 10 of them had rifles with limited filled magazines at the very least.
Farrah and Alfie didn’t hesitate to help...
As soon as the rifles became useless, they charged with their blades.
Together, they managed to bring down one of the Sentinels while the others focused on the remaining ones.
"This isn’t good..." Alfie said.
His Gladiator strength allowed him to pin the Sentinel down, while Farrah’s sword strikes pierced its core. The machine collapsed in sparks and smoke.
However, none of them were happy about the situation.
Around them, chaos reigned. The Spyder units skittered across walls, firing bursts that tore through defenders.
As for the remaining Sentinels, they were still being held down by the other fighters.
Still, after helping each other, they managed to bring down all the Spyder and Sentinel Units...
Boom!
Suddenly, the leaders were blown away by the Tyrant.
Without waiting, the machine unleashed waves of fire, reducing their defenses to ash!
"Run!"
"We can’t win!"
"Hide! Let the Tyrant be, don’t aggro it!"
The battle was brutal.
Twelve survivors died in the fighting... Even if there were survivors, their limbs were lost, and some had heavy injuries.
Even the leaders themselves were crippled.
Needless to say, Alfie and Farrah wanted to run away as well.
However, the leader called them out and pressed a potion into their hands.
The two recognized it. It was the Gene Stimulant!
"Please save our shelter..." The leader said.
Though it was surprising that the man didn’t consume it himself, the two didn’t ask any questions.
Without hesitation, they consumed the potion that burned in their throats... However, it didn’t take long before strength surged back into their bodies.
Together, they faced the Tyrant.
"That’s a lot of experience points. Can we really win?" Alfie muttered.
"Even if we can’t, we can escape. The Gene Stimulant lasts for 10 minutes."
And so, side by side, Farrah with her Spirit Knight talent and Alfie with his Gladiator talent, charged the Field Tyrant.
But then, something changed.
The Tyrant paused. Its sensors shifted, its head turning away from Farrah and Alfie. The flamethrowers hissed, but they didn’t fire. Instead, the machine focused on another location.
Farrah frowned while lowering her blade slightly. "What’s it doing?" she muttered.
Alfie was also confused. "Something’s wrong."
And then they saw it... A lone survivor appeared, rushing toward the Field Tyrant... He was accompanied by an advanced Sentinel, unlike anything they had ever encountered.

"Has it been a day?" Farrah muttered as she clutched her stomach...
With her Survivor Title, her satiety wasn’t easily decreased, but she still had to eat once a day to survive.
[ Title Effect: Satiety decreases more slowly.
Survivors can endure longer without food before hunger penalties occur. ]
Anyway, the last meal she had was an MRE.
She recalled that only three boxes remained, and they were even from the fallen leaders’ vault.
For thirty‐two people, it was barely anything.
Even rationed to one meal a day, the supplies would vanish quickly.
Thankfully, with their Title and Gene Enhancements, it allowed most of them to survive on less.
Nonetheless, it felt like they were just trying to survive because of it...
They didn’t feel energetic or even capable of fighting long battles.
Farrah often thought about that as she watched the new leaders.
They needed some improvement or changes...
Unfortunately, she really had no say in this shelter.
The leaders were the oldest among the survivors, chosen by necessity rather than skill.
Their voices carried authority, but they would sometimes make bad decisions...
Well, they weren’t Foreign Survivors like her and Alfie.
They hadn’t been pulled from Earth, dropped into this world with strange talents and the burden of adapting.
For them, Farrah and Alfie were outsiders.
They were only within the top 10 strongest fighters in Haven‐62...
Indeed, among the thirty-two, there were another eight who could stand against the machines.
"This shelter has no future..." Farrah muttered to herself as she swung her sword for practice...
Farrah’s Spirit Knight talent gave her a bond with her blade.
It strengthened her strikes, and it allowed her to obtain Gene Skills that could empower her Talent as a Spirit Knight.
"Ssshhh...
Don’t say that.
That old man might hear you..." Alfie said.
Alfie’s Gladiator talent made him really good in combat, his endurance and raw power could even be compared to their strongest fighter right now.
Still, because he lacked Spirit Points, he could barely use his Gene Skills.
Nonetheless, each day, they trained together in the courtyard.
They sparred until sweat soaked their clothes, until their muscles burned, until they reminded themselves that they were still alive and could always get stronger.
Well, they had to work hard since they weren’t even fighters back on Earth...
"Ah!
Farrah, that’s..." Alfie said as he worried look at the shelter’s gate.
This happened during one of those sparring sessions...
Apparently, their base had been found by the Tyrant!
The alarms rang out...
From the horizon, the machines advanced...
There were Sentinels, Spyder units, and towering above them, a Field Tyrant armed with flamethrowers.
The survivors scrambled to defend the shelter...
About 10 of them had rifles with limited filled magazines at the very least.
Farrah and Alfie didn’t hesitate to help...
As soon as the rifles became useless, they charged with their blades.
Together, they managed to bring down one of the Sentinels while the others focused on the remaining ones.
"This isn’t good..." Alfie said.
His Gladiator strength allowed him to pin the Sentinel down, while Farrah’s sword strikes pierced its core.
The machine collapsed in sparks and smoke.
However, none of them were happy about the situation.
Around them, chaos reigned.
The Spyder units skittered across walls, firing bursts that tore through defenders.
As for the remaining Sentinels, they were still being held down by the other fighters.
Still, after helping each other, they managed to bring down all the Spyder and Sentinel Units...
Boom!
Suddenly, the leaders were blown away by the Tyrant.
Without waiting, the machine unleashed waves of fire, reducing their defenses to ash!
"Run!"
"We can’t win!"
"Hide!
Let the Tyrant be, don’t aggro it!"
The battle was brutal.
Twelve survivors died in the fighting...
Even if there were survivors, their limbs were lost, and some had heavy injuries.
Even the leaders themselves were crippled.
Needless to say, Alfie and Farrah wanted to run away as well.
However, the leader called them out and pressed a potion into their hands.
The two recognized it.
It was the Gene Stimulant!
"Please save our shelter..." The leader said.
Though it was surprising that the man didn’t consume it himself, the two didn’t ask any questions.
Without hesitation, they consumed the potion that burned in their throats...
However, it didn’t take long before strength surged back into their bodies.
Together, they faced the Tyrant.
"That’s a lot of experience points.
Can we really win?" Alfie muttered.
"Even if we can’t, we can escape.
The Gene Stimulant lasts for 10 minutes."
And so, side by side, Farrah with her Spirit Knight talent and Alfie with his Gladiator talent, charged the Field Tyrant.
But then, something changed.
The Tyrant paused.
Its sensors shifted, its head turning away from Farrah and Alfie.
The flamethrowers hissed, but they didn’t fire.
Instead, the machine focused on another location.
Farrah frowned while lowering her blade slightly.
"What’s it doing?" she muttered.
Alfie was also confused.
"Something’s wrong."
And then they saw it...
A lone survivor appeared, rushing toward the Field Tyrant...
He was accompanied by an advanced Sentinel, unlike anything they had ever encountered.

chapters.title: Chapter 104: The New Tyrant
paragraphs: "What the heck?"
Farrah’s eyes squinted as the figure came into view.

At first glance, she thought he couldn’t be a Foreign Survivor like her and Alfie. His gear was different, far beyond the rough, practical Tier‐1 Survivor Gear they had been given when they were transported here.

She remembered her own outfit clearly... a plain shirt under a dark jacket, durable pants with six pockets, sturdy boots, and a belt with simple pouches. It wasn’t stylish, but it was functional, meant for survival.
Alfie’s was the same. Every Foreign Survivor she had met wore that same uniform. They were durable and not easily scratched as well. It was as if there were some kind of unseen enchantments to them.
But this man... his gear was different, far beyond the rough Tier‐1 outfits she and Alfie had worn since arriving here.
His jacket looked sturdier, with extra padding across the chest and shoulders. It wouldn’t even be surprising if it were bulletproof.

His boots looked solid, with protective guards around the ankles and shins, while his pants weren’t the plain kind either. They were armor-plated at the knees and thighs, clearly made for combat and movement.
It was survival gear, but clearly upgraded in many ways.
Then, Farrah’s gaze shifted to the machine beside him.

The impressive humanoid Sentinel was unlike any she had ever seen. It was slim, standing just under seven feet tall, and its frame wasn’t making loud noises when moving, unlike the other Sentinels that felt like they were rattling whenever they walked.
’This mech soldier... Is it really human-made?’Farrah couldn’t believe that such a machine could become allied to a human.
In any case, she also noticed that it carried a bulky rifle, but it did not fire gunpowder rounds!
Bang!
Farrah and Alfie saw it... When the mechanical raised the weapon and pulled the trigger, a block of metal shot forward with terrifying force, tearing through the air with a sound like thunder...
The slug smashed into the Field Tyrant’s shoulder, denting the armor and forcing the massive machine to stagger back a step!
Farrah flinched at the impact. She had seen rifles before, but nothing like this.
The sheer force of the shot made the Tyrant shift its balance with its flamethrowers sputtering for a moment.
It actually slowed it down...!
Both Farrah and Alfie were shocked upon seeing this.
It was simply incredible.
Then, they saw the man behind the mechanical soldier also make his move...
"It’s a good thing it’s already damaged. This should be doable." Kai muttered as he decided to steal this Field Tyrant and get a bunch of Experience Points from it!
Thud!
Atom’s first slug had dented its shoulder, but that wasn’t enough.
His Level 3 Keen Sense made him aware of the condition of the machine. From the hiss of pressure valves, the faint glow of overheated joints, and even the way its weight shifted wasn’t missed...
Weaknesses stood out in him!
"Atom, knee joint," Kai ordered...
The Sentinel raised its rifle, and just like before, the weapon’s discharge ripped through the air!
Bang!
The slug smashed into the Tyrant’s knee, tearing through armor.
The impact forced the machine off-center! It was now struggling to keep its balance.
Kai then sprinted, closing the distance. He vaulted onto a shattered barricade and soon, his Spirit energy gathered around him...
[ Spirit Pulse (Level 2): Releases a controlled burst of Spirit Energy that can hit a target within a short radius. Consumes Spirit upon activation.
Activation Cost: 70 SP ]
Indeed, he had already leveled it up twice using 2 Skill Points and lowered its cost to 70 SP instead of 100 SP!
Soon, a controlled burst of Spirit Energy erupted, striking the Tyrant square in the chest.
Kai’s eyes lit up as he knew that the impact fried its wiring! After all, it was about to use its flamethrower, but it just spat some sparks before going silent!
The blast had definitely scorched its internals.
Then, Kai landed, rolled, and snapped his revolver up.
Two shots rang out, both hitting the sensor cluster on its head!
It was a lucky shot!
Still, the damage triggered a harsh mechanical screech, followed by the sweep of its arm!
The blow caught Kai across the ribs, hurling him into a pile of rubble.
Even without looking, Kai knew that his health bar plummeted! Blood was filling his mouth, and pain was radiating through his chest.
He forced himself upright, refusing to stay down.
Atom then made its move...

The Sentinel’s rifle fired again, and another metal bullet tore into the Tyrant’s shoulder to divert its attention. The impact forced the Tyrant to tilt, and now, its focus was split between Kai and Atom’s support fire.
Atom did its best to get the Tyrant’s attention...
Then, it was at this point that Kai’s Passive Skill was triggered. It was a good thing he had also leveled it up!

[ Battle Trance (Level 3): When Health drops to 35% or below, the user automatically enters a combat trance. In this state, attack power and defense are greatly increased, pain response is suppressed, and survival instincts are heightened. It lasts 10 minutes or until the user’s health reached 50%. ]
Pain had dulled, and his vision changed... Somehow, every movement of the Tyrant slowed, its attacks became predictable, and its weak points also became glaringly obvious.
"Whoa~ This feels good." Kai thought as he stood to his feet.
Then, he dashed in, using his Spirit Pulse again!
This time at the already damaged knee!
Bang!
The joint blew apart and finally the Field Tyrant collapsed!
"Atom, the core!"
The Sentinel fired. The metal bullet hammered into the Tyrant’s chest, splitting the armor wide and exposing the glowing core!
Kai then climbed onto its damaged arm and checked the core... It was different from the furnace he was expecting...
Nonetheless, it was still the same Tyrant like before...
Then, just like that, he fired point-blank.
Bang!
[ Enemy Unit Destroyed: War Tyrant (C) ]
[ Experience Points distributed among all participants. ]
[ +2,400 Experience Points ]
[ You have obtained a Survivor Medal x1 ]

chapters.title: Chapter 105: Rewards and Recruitment
paragraphs: Kai blinked at the notification as he didn’t expect that it would have a different name.
It wasn’t a Field Tyrant at all. The system had classified it as a War Tyrant, and Kai wasn’t exactly sure, but he felt that it was a stronger variant.
’I guess I’m lucky its joints were already damaged.’He mused.
And more than that, it had dropped something new, a Survivor Medal!
The Field Tyrants they eliminated didn’t drop it before, so he knew that this War Tyrant was definitely special.
’A Survivor Medal just like that... This is just so perfect.’Kai clenched his fist in excitement. He just got a report that the Gene Trader had been found.
With another Survivor Medal, he could exchange more from the Gene Trader!
But the system wasn’t finished yet!
A familiar message came, it was something he had also obtained before when eliminating the first Field Tyrant!
[ Congratulations! You are the first Survivor to eliminate a War Tyrant (C). ]
[ Hint: Only the first elimination of each C‐Grade and higher unit can provide special rewards! ]
[ You can select one reward: Instant Experience Potion x2, Energy Cores x2, Random Gift Pack x2, Random Weapon Blueprint x2, Material Treasure Chest x2 ]
Kai grinned after as he saw this.
"Finally... something worth the risk."

Without hesitation, he chose the Random Weapon Blueprint. He had already selected the Energy Cores before, so he could help the others break the limit of Level 5 or use it to power their Plasma Rifles... Now, it was time to use it for his shelter.
[ Reward Selected: Random Weapon Blueprint x2 ]
[ Item has been added to your inventory. System rewards do not consume inventory slots. ]
Kai was satisfied with this result. He would check the blueprint later, but for now, his attention was drawn to movement ahead.
Two figures approached cautiously.
They weren’t enemies. They were the survivors from the shelter attacked by the War Tyrant.
Of course, their gear gave them away immediately. They wore the familiar Tier‐1 Survivor Gear after all.
It was the same plain dark jackets, durable pants, and sturdy boots he had worn when he first arrived.
Kai raised a hand, signaling Atom to stand down. The Sentinel lowered its rifle and its eyes or optics started dimming slightly, no longer locked onto the newcomers.
The pair stopped a few meters away. One was a young woman with bruises and small cuts on her face and hands.

The other was a taller man who seemed a little tense. Nonetheless, just like Kai, they also had revolvers holstered at their side. They must’ve selected the Weapons Gift Pack at the start of the event.
Then, the woman spoke first. "I’m Farrah. This is Alfie. We... saw what you did."
Alfie nodded, though he was still a little wary. "That thing was tearing through the area. We didn’t think anyone could bring it down so easily."
As he said this, he glanced at Atom, hoping that the man in front of them would introduce himself and perhaps recruit them in their shelter.

Well, to be honest, this Haven-62 was already hopeless... Of course, they wouldn’t be so cruel as to leave the resident while they were injured, but their desire to live was still strong. They have left so many things back on Earth, and they have seen other survivors die.
Those deaths didn’t look good, as many of them were vaporized by plasma guns. They could almost guarantee that death here wouldn’t bring them back to Earth, as nothing happened.
They had a strong feeling that this wasn’t some sort of game but reality.
Meanwhile, Kai studied them for a moment. Their tone wasn’t hostile, but cautious. Survivors protecting their shelter, just like he had once done.
"I’m Kai," he said simply. "And this is Atom... an A-Grade Sentinel I found." He gestured to the Sentinel beside him.
Of course, none of them noticed something off about his name just yet.
Their eyes were too focused on the machine.

"You... you actually have a Sentinel under your command? Are you an Augmented Human? Is it possible to join your shelter? We will not be a burden. We have special Gene Skills that boost our talents." Farrah said, and she was filled with conviction.
"Yes! We may be weak right now. But we’re going to become really strong." Alfie added.
Kai didn’t answer immediately.
He finally realized that these two guys didn’t know who he was.
’I thought my name was unique though...’He mused as he initially thought that they would recognize his name from the Leaderboard with his unusual name.
’Still... Do I look like one of those powerful Augmented Humans?’ He couldn’t help but smile as he reached this thought.
Anyway, he was actually a bit concerned about whether to accept these guys or not.
He still didn’t forget what had happened to Samantha and those guys who had run away with his resources before.
However, it also didn’t change the fact that these guys would indeed have the potential to become even stronger.
Kai’s gaze then lingered on the wreckage of the War Tyrant before turning back to Farrah and Alfie.
He decided to test the two on how honest they could be...

"I can’t say much about myself, but I’ll be back later to collect the valuable loot from this War Tyrant. I want you two to gather and guard it for me. When I return, we’ll discuss whether you’re fit to join my shelter."
’Finally!’
Farrah and Alfie exchanged a quick glance, then nodded in unison. The fact that they were given a chance was already a huge deal for them!
They understood this was a test. If they wanted Kai’s trust, they had to prove themselves.
Besides, neither of them could leave yet.
Haven‐62 was in ruins, and too many survivors were injured. Abandoning them now would only deepen their guilt. Protecting the wounded was the least they could do.
Kai gave a short nod of approval. "Good. Don’t disappoint me."
With that, he turned away while Atom stepped beside him.
At this point, Kai’s mind had already shifted to the next objective.
Russel had reported the location of the Gene Trader, and with another Survivor Medal in his inventory, Kai knew this was the perfect chance to strengthen himself further!
’Let’s see what you have for me...’

chapters.title: Chapter 106: Rewarded
paragraphs: After giving Farrah and Alfie their test, he turned his back and began walking.
He didn’t run since conserving energy was critical. The industrial zone was hours away, and if enemies appeared, exhaustion could really kill him...
He needs to be in good form at the very least. After all, he spent 140 Spirit Points during the battle against the War Tyrant.
It means that he couldn’t use his Spirit Pulse for a while.
"Right... I should check it now..." Kai muttered as he looked around.
Atom marched beside him with its optics scanning the surroundings.
He then spoke quietly, "Stay on guard. If anything moves, you react first." The Sentinel’s eyes lit up briefly, acknowledging the command.
As they moved through the broken road, Kai opened his interface.
His inventory appeared before his eyes, and he scrolled to the newest additions...
"Ahhh... It’s here." Kai muttered, seeing the two paper icons in his inventory beside the Survivor Medal icon.
As he checked it, Kai noticed their names, Steelbreaker Sword Blueprint and Repeater Crossbow Blueprint.
Without hesitation, he clicked the item to see the description.
[ Weapon Blueprint: Steelbreaker Sword
Grade: C
A longsword design focused on durability and reach.
The blade structure is strengthened to withstand repeated strikes against armored targets.
Requires standard forging tools and refined metal to craft.
Optimized grip and weight distribution allow steady handling during prolonged use. ]
"Wow... This is nice, but something’s missing." He muttered as he felt that this wouldn’t be enough for a blueprint.
Then, it was at this point that another set of notifications appeared.
[ Do you want to learn the Blueprint? ]
[ Warning: Learning this Blueprint will consume the item. Once learned, you will permanently gain the ability to craft the Steelbreaker Sword, even without prior forging knowledge. ]
[ Note: Weapons crafted directly by you will retain system effects. Copies made by ordinary craftsmen will not inherit system effects. ]
’I knew it... So it’s consumable... once I learn it, the blueprint vanishes, and I’ll be able to craft it myself with system effects...’
He rubbed his chin as he slowly read the information.
"If I take it, I’ll have the knowledge forever. But I can’t spend my days in the forge... the shelter needs me managing everything else. If someone else learns it, that might be better..."
Kai closed the interface for now.
’Better to hold onto it until I decide who should learn it.’
He then turned to the next item. It had a lower grade this time but he didn’t mind.
[ Weapon Blueprint: Repeater Crossbow
Grade: D
A crossbow design modified for faster firing.
Equipped with a simple mechanical reloading system that allows multiple shots in quick succession.
Requires wood, iron fittings, and basic mechanical parts to craft.
It had a special feature that fires three bolts rapidly, but reduces accuracy. ]
Then, the same notification about him being asked to learn the blueprint had also appeared.
Now, Kai’s eyes shone as he read the descriptions.
"Perfect... one for close combat, one for ranged suppression." He clenched his fist, already imagining how these weapons could change the tide for his shelter.
Anyway, Kai closed the interface and exhaled slowly.
"We’ll need resources to build them... but once we do, the shelter will advance, and even with another Mech Siege, we’ll be fine."
That was his aim all along...
As he continued moving, the industrial zone finally appeared ahead.
Somewhere within, Russel had already found the cloaked figure who was also the Gene Trader.
"It’s too eerie... Atom, stay close." Kai said as he tightened his grip on his revolver and kept walking.
Then, it was at this point that his radio turned on.
"Kai!" Russell’s voice came in.
"We’re under attack! Mutated humans! Same kind that hit the shelter! We’re pinned down inside the factory ruins!"
Gunfire echoed faintly through the static, followed by Gabby’s voice shouting orders.
Kai’s expression hardened. "Position?"
"North sector of the industrial zone, near the collapsed conveyor lines!" Russell shouted back. "We’re holding them off, but there are too many!"
"Stay alive. I’m coming." Kai snapped the radio shut and broke into a run. There was no need to reserve his energy.
As a matter of fact, this was the reason why he kept his stamina at an all-time high!
It didn’t take him that long before he started hearing some gunshots, though it was a bit too far.
"We’re going to rescue our friends." Kai said to Atom beside him.
It didn’t nod, but Kai knew that its sensors were scanning for threats.
Then, as Kai approached the area, the sounds of battle grew louder...
The revolver shots, the groans and shrieks of the mutants, and the crash of debris were getting close!
Soon, he rounded a broken wall and saw them... Russell, Gabby, and Dylan crouched behind rusted machinery, firing desperately at a swarm of mutated humans!
He had many questions about how they got into this situation when they should be hanging around the Gene Trader... However, there was no time for that!
The mutants looked terrifying with their bodies damaged by infection.
Most of them had pale skin stretched over bulging muscles, and their movements looked almost feral...
Kai didn’t hesitate. "Atom, suppressing fire!"
The Sentinel raised its rifle.
Bang!

The first metal brick or bullet ripped through the nearest mutant, but it didn’t stop there! The dense metal tore straight through three more bodies lined up behind it, leaving a trail of flesh and blood...
Bang!
The second shot followed immediately, greatly easing the pressure from the three.

This bullet punched through a cluster of attackers. The slug smashed through a chest, shattered a shoulder, and destroyed some ribs before it finally embedded itself in the wall with another head. Just like that, it dropped four mutants in one strike.
As for the final bullet that Atom had, Kai ordered not to fire it just yet. Atom had already done its job, thinning the swarm and giving Russell’s team breathing room.
Now, it was Kai’s turn! He dashed forward with his revolvers to eliminate the remaining mutants!

chapters.title: Chapter 107: Piles
paragraphs: A few more mutants charged ahead...
Their bulging muscles could be seen swaying as if they were so excited to see humans.
Up until now, Kai had no clue why these creatures were being so aggressive toward them or if they actually planned to just kill or eat them.
But their purpose wasn’t important to Kai and everyone else.
Atom’s two devastating shots had already thinned the swarm, and they should be able to win this...
Kai didn’t hesitate. He raised both revolvers, one in each hand, and advanced.
Well, he didn’t have an aim similar to Ralph’s, so he had to compensate by getting closer!
His arms moved, and each squeeze of the trigger dropped another mutant.
Bang! Bang! Bang!
A skull shattered, a chest burst open, and another collapsed with a bullet through its throat.
The revolvers fired steadily...
Meanwhile, Russell, Gabby, and Dylan had no time to reload!
Their revolvers were empty, and fumbling with ammunition would only get them killed. Instead, they drew their hatchets and gripped them tightly as the mutants closed the distance.
"Stay close!" Russell shouted, swinging his weapon into the nearest attacker.
Thud!
The hatchet bit deep into the mutant’s shoulder, forcing it back with a shriek!
Though these creatures are crazy and wouldn’t stop attacking them, they still had an instinct to back off a little after getting injured.
However, that was only for a brief moment, as it seemed that they would always forget that they were harmed, and they would just charge forward again!
They were truly close to a Zombie to a certain point.
"Aacck! This is annoying!
Gabby ducked to avoid the pouncing mutant... Then, she countered with her hatchet flashing upward to split a mutant’s jaw.
Blood sprayed as she turned away, narrowly avoiding another claw swipe.
Dylan followed suit, hacking into a mutant’s ribs...
"I don’t taste good! Stay away from me!" He shouted.
This time, Kai also emptied the last rounds from his revolvers. All of his shots were lethal.
The final mutant he hit dropped with a hole through its chest. Unlike the Zombies, these guys could be killed by shattering their hearts or cutting their limbs, or if they lose enough blood.
Soon, Kai holstered his weapons.
"Time for steel," he muttered.
Kai drew a combat knife in one hand and a heavy axe in the other. They were both from his Enhanced Weapon Gift Pack.
At this point, only seven mutants were left!

The next mutant charged at him, but Kai just stepped aside before, driving the knife into its throat. He ripped it free in one move before spinning to bring the axe down on another attacker. The blade cleaved through bone, splitting the mutant’s skull in half!
’Whoa... I just did that.’
Even Kai himself was shocked by the move he made. His Keen Sense allowed him to easily understand his surroundings, and it naturally helped him in his battle!

Since he was now level 16, his speed and strength seemed to have really helped. Of course, he wasn’t feeling any guilt about eliminating these enemies since, in his mind, they weren’t humans at all. They were just creatures, perhaps zombies that needed to be killed!
Russell then fought beside him, his hatchet striking again and again. He wasn’t as fast as Kai, but his blows were solid, keeping the mutants from overwhelming him...

Gabby, on the other hand, wasn’t that strong. However, with the sharp hatchet, she was carving shallow but effective wounds. She may fail cutting off limbs or killing the mutants, but injuring them and slowing them down could help his friends!
Dylan indeed stepped in and struck their limbs and torsos, forcing the mutants back or killing them off if he got lucky!
Together, the four survivors formed a solid line!
"Just five more!"
Kai’s knife flashed in quick thrusts while his axe smashed through skulls and spines.
Russell’s steady swings kept their flank secure while Gabby’s speed helped them slow down the others.
"Haha! This is so easy with you here, Leader!" Dylan shouted as he cleaved another mutant!
After a few more moments, the last mutant charged at Kai.
Then, he met it head-on with his knife, plunging into its chest while the axe swung upward, splitting its skull.
He really likes this move now, as he repeated it a few times during the battle.
"Finally... We’re done here."
The creature collapsed before it started twitching once before lying still.
It was at this point that Kai finally looked at the gathered notifications at the corner of his eyes.
[ +250 Experience Points ]
[ +250 Experience Points ]
[ +250 Experience Points ]
[ You have leveled up! ]
[ +250 Experience Points ]
[ +250 Experience Points ]
These messages repeated a few dozen times, and as expected, he finally leveled up and it happened mid-battle!
It was no wonder he felt his Spirit Energy and Health in full again!
Kai knew that this quick level up was also thanks to the War Tyrant that gave him huge Experience Points a while ago!
However, Kai didn’t check the complete level-up notification yet...
His attention turned to Atom.
Atom was standing several meters away, its body surrounded by a small mountain of corpses.
Apparently, while Kai and the others had been locked in their desperate melee, Atom had been fighting on its own flank, eliminating another wave of mutants that had arrived unnoticed!
Russell was shocked after realizing what had just happened. "Wait... don’t tell me it handled all of those by itself? Atom! You’re so cool!"
Gabby let out a short laugh, shaking her head. "We were struggling like crazy, and Atom was just... stacking bodies. What a great Sentinel you are. It’s a good thing you’re an ally."
Dylan also chuckled while wiping sweat from his brow. He really thought he would die today.
"Thank you, Atom. I know you can’t speak, but I’m sure you can hear me."
Kai allowed himself a faint smile before he turned to the three...
"So... What really happened here? Where is the Gene Trader?"

chapters.title: Chapter 108: The First Gene Trader
paragraphs: The three looked at each other before explaining what had truly happened.
Russell spoke first.

"We actually saw him, Kai. The cloaked figure was inside one of the ruined buildings. He had luggage around him, so we contacted you immediately about it. We’re sure that it was the Gene Trader... But as soon as we stepped into that area, the mutants started appearing out of nowhere."

Gabby added quickly, "It wasn’t random. I’m sure it was the moment we crossed into what felt like his territory that they came at us. Dozens of them at first, but they keep appearing when we try getting closer to the cloaked figure. We couldn’t even get close to him."
Dylan shook his head. He was really frustrated about this.
"We thought we could approach, but it was like the place itself was guarded. Just like what Gabby said, every time we tried to move forward, more mutants showed up..."

Russel continued. "So we started moving away instead. We realized it a bit too late... For some reason, we can’t approach him directly. It’s like the Gene Trader’s chamber is protected, or maybe he set it up that way."
Kai gently nodded after hearing their explanation. "Did he leave after the mutants appeared?"

Gabby frowned. "He didn’t move, Kai. He just stood there, watching us from the darkness... It felt like he wanted to see if we could survive before letting us near. Not really sure... Maybe he just didn’t care what happened to us."
Dylan "So yeah... we found him. But we couldn’t reach him... You can probably try."
Kai finally understood.
"Alright. You’ll guide me back to where you saw him. But only I’ll enter. Atom will also with you three... if more mutants show up, it’ll protect you."
Russell frowned. "You’re going in alone?"
Kai nodded. "Yes. I’ll test it myself. No point risking everyone."
Gabby sighed but nodded. "We’ll position ourselves well. Just... be careful."
Dylan muttered, "We’ll cover you from outside."
With that settled, the group began moving through the broken roads and collapsed structures once more.
Atom marched silently behind them, scanning the ruins, while Kai walked at the front.
As they advanced, Kai finally turned his attention back to the glowing corner of his interface. The level-up notification was waiting.
[ You have leveled up! ]
[ Level: 17 ]
[ Health Points +5 ]
[ Spirit Points +1 ]
[ Physique Rating has slightly improved! ]
[ Skill Points +1 ]
Kai’s eyes widened slightly. "A Skill Point..." he muttered.

He was happy. Skill Points were rare, usually earned through special rewards or milestones. Level 17 wasn’t a milestone, so he wasn’t sure why the system had granted one, but he wasn’t about to complain.
Still, he couldn’t help but realize how slow it was to get stronger.
Leveling up through enemy subjugation wasn’t as good as leveling up through Gene Enhancement. The increases to Health and Spirit Points were too low.
The only advantage was the fact that killing enemies gave far more experience overall, letting him reach milestones faster and claim bigger rewards.
Kai closed the interface, satisfied with the small reward he obtained.
"This will help," he whispered.
Russell glanced at him. He realized that Kai had a better mood now, but he didn’t ask questions.
Soon, Kai’s focus was shifted back to the mission. The Gene Trader was waiting and he had to be prepared.
After a few more minutes, the three guided him deeper into the industrial zone, toward the ruined building where they had first seen the cloaked figure.
"It’s here..." Russel said, pointing at the building.
Kai slowed his pace and nodded.
He didn’t rush in immediately. Instead, he observed the place carefully.
The building wasn’t that huge... Looking through the open door, he noticed that the chamber was dark, its walls were cracked, but there was no foul smell whatsoever.
Soon, he saw the Gene Trader or the cloaked figure at the far end of the dark room... Just like what they said, it had some luggage around, like some kind of merchant.
Still, Kai didn’t rush and looked for possible threat.

There were shattered beams leaning against each other, forming rough shapes that blocked most of the light. The floor was uneven, littered with broken tiles and rusted scraps of machinery. It wasn’t the kind of place anyone would choose to live in... but for the Gene Trader, it made sense.
Kai thought to himself...
’So this is the kind of place they go into... places abandoned, places where no one else dares to stay. This is a good reference in case I need to find them again.’
He then stepped forward, crossing the threshold of the chamber.
Thud. His boot hit the floor... but nothing happened.
Then, he took another step. Still nothing.
Third... Fourth...
As he got closer, Kai realized there was no problem at all. The mutants didn’t appear!
Then it struck him.
’Maybe only Foreign Survivors like me can approach the Gene Trader...’
This actually made sense. At the very least, his three subordinates weren’t qualified yet. After all, he recalled Hale Libra, a resident of this world, should’ve been able to approach a Gene Trader.
Perhaps there was a level requirement for the natives here, unlike for him and other Foreign Survivors.
Then, as he finally stood before the cloaked figure, there were no greetings, no words.
Instead, the Gene Trader raised a hand and placed a crystal in front of him. The crystal floated upward, glowing faintly, before transforming into a notification window!
Kai’s eyes widened as the interface unfolded before him. Apparently, he could browse items directly!
Surprisingly, the first thing he noticed was the fact that there were two tabs.
The first tab displayed items that could be traded for Survivor Medals. It was currency only Foreign Survivors like him could obtain.
The second tab was different. It only accepted Top‐Grade Energy Cores, rare resources that could only be obtained from high-level A.I. Machine!
’So this is how it works...’Kai thought as he looked at the Gene Trader, whose eyes were fixed on him.
’What? Are you intimidating me?’

"It’s here..." Russel said, pointing at the building.
Kai slowed his pace and nodded.
He didn’t rush in immediately.
Instead, he observed the place carefully.
The building wasn’t that huge...
Looking through the open door, he noticed that the chamber was dark, its walls were cracked, but there was no foul smell whatsoever.
Soon, he saw the Gene Trader or the cloaked figure at the far end of the dark room...
Just like what they said, it had some luggage around, like some kind of merchant.
Still, Kai didn’t rush and looked for possible threat.
There were shattered beams leaning against each other, forming rough shapes that blocked most of the light.
The floor was uneven, littered with broken tiles and rusted scraps of machinery.
It wasn’t the kind of place anyone would choose to live in... but for the Gene Trader, it made sense.
Kai thought to himself...
’So this is the kind of place they go into... places abandoned, places where no one else dares to stay.
This is a good reference in case I need to find them again.’
He then stepped forward, crossing the threshold of the chamber.
Thud.
His boot hit the floor... but nothing happened.
Then, he took another step.
Still nothing.
Third...
Fourth...
As he got closer, Kai realized there was no problem at all.
The mutants didn’t appear!
Then it struck him.
’Maybe only Foreign Survivors like me can approach the Gene Trader...’
This actually made sense.
At the very least, his three subordinates weren’t qualified yet.
After all, he recalled Hale Libra, a resident of this world, should’ve been able to approach a Gene Trader.
Perhaps there was a level requirement for the natives here, unlike for him and other Foreign Survivors.
Then, as he finally stood before the cloaked figure, there were no greetings, no words.
Instead, the Gene Trader raised a hand and placed a crystal in front of him.
The crystal floated upward, glowing faintly, before transforming into a notification window!
Kai’s eyes widened as the interface unfolded before him.
Apparently, he could browse items directly!
Surprisingly, the first thing he noticed was the fact that there were two tabs.
The first tab displayed items that could be traded for Survivor Medals.
It was currency only Foreign Survivors like him could obtain.
The second tab was different.
It only accepted Top‐Grade Energy Cores, rare resources that could only be obtained from high-level A.I.
Machine!
’So this is how it works...’Kai thought as he looked at the Gene Trader, whose eyes were fixed on him.
’What?
Are you intimidating me?’

chapters.title: Chapter 109: The Gene Trader’s Store
paragraphs: Kai smiled, but the Gene Trader didn’t react, so he focused his attention on the store window...
[ Gene Trader’s Store ]
[ Survivor Medal Items ] [ Energy Core Items ]
Kai selected the Survivor Medal Items tab.
The interface expanded, revealing a long list of incredible items.
"Now... What do we have here?" Kai muttered as his eyes scanned each entry carefully.
The first batch he noticed was the Gene Enhancement Serums.
[ Super Gene Enhancement Serum: A basic serum that slightly improves genetic compatibility, granting small boosts to overall stats and a high chance of awakening a Gene Skill.
Cost: 4 Survivor Medals ]
[ Alpha Gene Enhancement Serum: A rare genetic resource that grants balanced boosts to overall stats and provides a small chance of awakening a Gene Skill.
Cost: 4 Survivor Medals ]
[ Prime Gene Enhancement Serum: A rare serum that focuses on greatly improving Physique and provides a small chance of awakening a Gene Skill.
Cost: 4 Survivor Medals ]

[ Mutagenic Gene Enhancement Serum: An unstable serum that grants massive boosts to overall stats but carries a high chance of mutation. Mutations may result in unpredictable abilities or severe drawbacks.
Cost: 1 Survivor Medal ]
"Ohhh?" Kai immediately noticed the difference between the three similar priced Serums... Although the Super Gene grants a small improvement, it actually has a high chance of awakening a Gene Skill!
As for the two others, they were already familiar serums, but this time, they had a clearer description.
"And they’re all cheap..." Kai muttered as he ignored the Mutagenic Gene.
Then, he paused...

He finally recalled that Diego and Santiago, those two wandering merchants who had visited their shelter with their escorts, sold Crimson Gene Enhancement Serum and Emerald Gene Enhancement Serum for 5 Survivor Medals each. Then, the Alpha Gene Serums were being sold for 15 Survivor Medals each!
"Those two profited a lot, huh." Kai muttered.
"Claire and the others will be mad if they learned about this. They got scammed."
He recalled how Claire and the others gathered their Survivor Medals to be able to purchase a vial of Alpha Gene Serum after all!
Anyway, he had 12 Survivor Medals at the moment, which means that he’d be able to purchase a 3 Alpha Serums if he really wanted.
But he continued checking the store...
[ Gene Stabilization Pill: Greatly reduces mutation risks during enhancement, ensuring safer upgrades.
Cost: 2 Survivor Medals ]
[ Rapid Recovery Pill: Restores stamina and accelerates healing.
Cost: 1 Survivor Medal ]
[ Neural Expansion Pill: Temporarily boosts cognitive function, improving focus and reaction speed during combat. Long-term use may unlock Gene Skill related to Spirit Energy control.
Cost: 2 Survivor Medals ]
"The Gene Trader really knows how to tempt survivors." Kai muttered after seeing the descriptions. They were certainly decent.
The Gene Stabilization Pill was definitely made to entice the Survivors into purchasing the Mutagenic Gene Enhancement Serum!
In any case, Kai finally turned to the most expensive items in the list.
[ Bloodbound Bracelet: A crimson band that absorbs the wearer’s blood and solidifies it into a blade. The weapon’s strength depends on the user’s vitality.
Cost: 5 Survivor Medals ]
[ Phantom Mask: A dark mask that alters facial features and disguises the wearer’s identity. It also dampens breathing sounds, making stealth easier.
Cost: 6 Survivor Medals ]
[ Dire Claw Gauntlet: Crafted from pale skeletal material that reshapes to fit the user’s hand, giving it a rigid, claw-like form.
Cost: 5 Survivor Medals ]
[ Chameleon Cloak: A cloak made of adaptive fibers that blend with the environment, reducing visibility.
Cost: 5 Survivor Medals ]
[ Venomfang Dagger: A curved blade that infuses the user’s blood into its edge, producing a toxic effect. The poison weakens enemies over time.
Cost: 6 Survivor Medals ]
"Ohhh... These things are expensive. Sera and Althea are so lucky." Kai muttered after seeing the items.
[ Gene Skill Crystal (Low‐Grade): A crystal that awakens an active or passive gene skill. The ability varies depending on the user’s genetic state.
Cost: 3 Survivor Medals ]
[ Random Gene Skill Crystal (Low‐Grade): A crystal that triggers a random bodily adjustment or passive skill, often minor but useful. The awakened gene skill depends on prior enhancements.
Cost: 2 Survivor Medals ]
[ Active Gene Skill Crystal (Mid-Grade): A crystal that awakens a powerful Active Gene Skill. The ability differs for each user, influenced by their physique and gene enhancements taken.
Cost: 7 Survivor Medals ]
[ Passive Gene Skill Crystal (Mid-Grade): A crystal that awakens a powerful Passive Gene Skill...
Cost: 7 Survivor Medals ]
[ Random Gene Skill Crystal (Mid-Grade): A crystal that awakens a powerful Random Gene Skill...
Cost: 7 Survivor Medals ]
Kai’s eyes narrowed as he scrolled through the crystals.
"Low‐grade... mid‐grade... random awakenings..." he muttered under his breath.
The descriptions made him pause. These weren’t fixed skills, they would awaken differently depending on the survivor’s body, their enhancements, or sheer luck.
Kai tapped the window lightly.
"So it’s not about choosing the skill. It’s about gambling on what my genes can unlock."
He smirked faintly...
"Cheap for low‐grade, but the mid‐grade ones... seven medals each. That’s steep."
His gaze lingered on the Random Gene Skill Crystal. "Guaranteed awakening, but no control. That’s dangerous... and tempting."
Kai exhaled slowly as he finally turned to the last batch...
This time, he finally found the item that Hale Libra used to show his status!
[ Status Crystal: A crystal that reveals the complete status of the person who activates it. Their name, title, level, skills, and stats are displayed clearly with a short cooldown.
Cost: 3 Survivor Medals ]
There was no clear number noted about the cooldown, but it didn’t matter. He was determined to have this Status Crystal!
After all, Russel and everyone else would be able to work harder if they could actually see their stats improving!
This would be one of the best motivators for them!
Still, the last two items surprised Kai...

[ Ocular Replacement Implant: A bioengineered eye designed to replace a missing or damaged one. It restores full vision immediately, grants Appraisal Ability, and integrates seamlessly with the body’s nervous system. It guarantees periodic headaches unless the user’s physique is strong enough to negate the strain.
Cost: 10 Survivor Medals ]
"You’re selling an eye?!"

chapters.title: Chapter 110: The Items and the Purchase
paragraphs: Kai was shocked to see that he could just purchase an eye here in case he got injured.
He definitely knew that this would be a game-changer for those who had already been injured. Then, he paused for a moment as he reread the description.
"Wait--Not just vision? An Appraisal ability too! That’s insane."
Appraisal Ability wasn’t something he could just ignore. This must be known by everyone.
"But headaches are guaranteed. Survivors would suffer unless their bodies could endure it. Still... for someone blind, this would be worth everything."
Kai exhaled slowly as he really liked this. "The Gene Trader isn’t just selling enhancements anymore. He’s selling replacements for body parts."
Then his gaze shifted to the next entry.

[ Basic Limb Reconstruction Capsule: A capsule that regrows a missing arm or leg through synthetic bones and accelerated tissue growth. The replacement grants superior strength and faster reflexes. The process gives some bouts of weakness and pain during adaptation, unless the user’s physique allows them to stabilize quickly.
Cost: 10 Survivor Medals ]
Kai’s eyes widened again. "A limb... rebuilt stronger than before."
He clenched his fists. "This isn’t just restoration. It’s basically augmentation. Survivors who lost arms or legs... they’d finally have a chance again."
However, it was expensive.
"But ten medals... that’s far too expensive. Most Survivors wouldn’t even be able to afford one yet. Still... if someone crippled could stand again, fight again... it would change everything."
In any case, this was the last item being sold in the store tab.
Finally, he turned his attention to the Energy Core tab.
The interface shifted, revealing a different set of items.
Most of them were similar to the items being sold in the Survivors Medal, like Status Crystals, Gene Skill Crystals, and Serums.
However, there were also unique entries here, items that weren’t available in the Survivor Medal tab.

[ Mutation Induction Serum: A volatile serum that increases lifespan and strengthens Gene Skills, but it guarantees bodily mutation. Effects are weaker compared to enhancement serums, but permanent. Common mutations include the growth of a third eye, an additional arm, or other unpredictable changes.
Cost: 30 Energy Cores ]
"Guaranteed mutation...? Not just a chance, but certainty." Kai wryly smiled after seeing this.
He felt that this was simply too much. Getting a third eye or an extra arm through this method was also quite weird!
Anyway, only the desperate ones would probably want to have something like this. This was especially true for those who don’t have access to Survivor Medals and could only trade with Energy Cores.
Anyway, Kai turned to the other items being sold. There were actually some simple ones, too.
[ Energy Infusion Crystal: A compact device that channels raw energy into the user’s body, temporarily boosting all stats. The effect fades after several hours, leaving the user drained.
Cost: 10 Energy Core ]
[ Vitality Infusion Crystal: A crystalline core that stabilizes internal organs, reinforcing them against strain. Survivors who suffer from hidden injuries or weak constitutions gain resilience.
Cost: 10 Energy Cores ]

[ Neural Sync Crystal: A rare crystal that enhances the connection between mind and body. Reaction speed, coordination, and focus are sharpened to unnatural levels. Long-term use may unlock advanced combat instincts or gene skills.
Cost: 13 Energy Cores ]
Kai muttered, "Temporary boosts... stabilizers... even sharper reflexes. These are decent, and they’re actually cheap."
Then his eyes caught another familiar entry.
[ Random Gene Skill Crystal (Low-Grade): A crystal that awakens a random Gene Skill. It sometimes produces unstable or unusual skills.
Cost: 35 Energy Cores ]
Kai frowned. "So even the crystals are different here. Energy-driven awakenings... more unstable, more unpredictable."
Anyway, he didn’t have enough cores, so he just continued checking to broaden his knowledge.
But then, something new appeared, items unlike anything he had seen before.
[ Spiritbound Monocle: A refined lens Artifact that requires Spirit Energy to activate. When worn, it could reveal hidden inscriptions, weak points, and concealed traps.
Cost: 15 Energy Cores ]
[ Phantom Gauntlet: A glove Artifact infused with Spirit Energy. When activated, it creates a spectral hand that can manipulate objects at a distance.
Cost: 30 Energy Cores ]
[ Noble’s Pendant: A pendant Artifact that amplifies Spirit Energy flow, allowing the wearer to use Gene Skills or Survivor Talents more efficiently.
Cost: 20 Energy Cores ]
Kai’s eyes widened.
"Artifacts...? These aren’t gene weapons. They’re accessories powered by Spirit Energy..."
He leaned closer, clearly fascinated by the discovery. "Monocles, gloves, pendants..."
Based on his understanding, these Artifacts were tools that don’t rely on genetic compatibility, but on spirit energy itself.
This is completely different.
Finally, Kai suddenly froze as he noticed the item at the very bottom of the list!
[ Gene Transfer Capsule: A capsule that allows the genetic traits of one person to be extracted and implanted into another with little risk.
Cost: 1,000 Energy Cores ]
He was stunned. "One thousand cores...? That’s absurd."
He squinted his eyes and studied the description.
"Extracting traits... implanting them into another... this isn’t just augmentation. This is theft... I wonder how many times this capsule can be used." He mused.
Well, there were no details after all. Even the pills and other consumables were greatly lacking in information. Perhaps, they would only be given once the event ended.
Anyway, he knew that his capsule would just stay here for a long time.
There was no way someone would have so many of these Energy Cores.
For a long moment, he stared at the glowing window, as he wanted to imprint all of them into his memory...
Then, with effort, he pulled himself back to reality.
He checked his balance. Twelve Survivor Medals...
It was enough for a few purchases, but nowhere near the terrifying items he had just seen.
Kai finally made his decision.
[ You have purchased Super Gene Enhancement Serum for 4 Survivor Medals. ]
[ You have purchased Status Crystal for 3 Survivor Medals. ]
[ You have purchased Chameleon Cloak: 5 Survivor Medals. ]
As soon as he confirmed the purchases, he wanted to check them immediately in his inventory.
However, another system window appeared!
[ Achievement Unlocked: First Transaction with the Gene Trader ]

chapters.title: Chapter 111: Experience Points
paragraphs: All the items were transferred to Kai’s inventory, and of course, they didn’t take up any space.
Still, he didn’t focus on that. He turned his attention to the achievement he had just obtained!
"First transaction with the Gene Trader..." Kai repeated softly.
’So I’m the first Foreign Survivor to buy something from this guy? I’m lucky...’
Then, it was followed by another notification and new items appearing in his inventory. Kai’s eyes widened as he checked it.
[ Achievement Unlocked: First Transaction with the Gene Trader ]
[ You have obtained 50% Discount Vouchers x2 and 75% Discount Voucher x1 as a reward. ]
[ Note: Vouchers may be applied to purchases in the Gene Trader’s Store, whether using Survivor Medals or Energy Cores. ]
Kai froze. "Discount vouchers...?!"
Now, this was an incredible reward!
"This is insane. I can actually cut the price of those expensive items... even the replacements!"
He clenched his fists, excitement surging through him. "Two halves and one three-quarters off... this is huge. I like this very much!"
He really felt like celebrating here. After all, he’d save a huge amount of Energy Cores or Survivor Medals if he were careful about this.
Then, it didn’t end there. After confirming that Kai was done with his purchase, the cloaked Gene Trader finally moved.
He put down the crystal, the faint glow faded from his hands.
This time, he turned to the luggage stacked around him.
Kai tilted his head, as he was curious about the situation.
’Is he selling other items aside from system items through the crystal? Or maybe he wanted to give another reward or something?’
In the end, he was right about the first part...
The cloaked trader raised his hand, and with a simple wave, the luggage snapped open. One after another, they unfolded, spilling their contents onto the ground!
"Whoa~"
Kai was basically watching magic! The Gene Trader seemed to have some kind of telekinetic ability!
’I want that too...’Kai thought. Well, who wouldn’t want to learn telekinesis?
Being able to control objects around you was definitely a sought-after ability.
He would be willing to pay an extra fee for that.
Unfortunately, the items being sold now didn’t seem to be too related to the Genetic Items.
Whoosh~
At this time, the trader spread out a huge mantle. The mantle itself seemed just like a worn fabric, more like a ragged peddler’s cloth than anything refined.
But as he laid it flat across the dirt, the items were carefully arranged on top like magic... It looked so mystical.
Kai’s eyes widened. The scene was surreal. He really wanted to have such an ability.
In any case, the mysterious Gene Trader, who had just shown Kai a system interface filled with impossible items, now looked like a normal street vendor.
He seemed interesting. A cloaked figure crouched over a spread of goods, selling them on the ground.
’Well... I guess he’s a peddler too.’Kai muttered as he looked at the items.
There were weapons, trinkets, and strange supplies appearing in front of him. Some were crude, others looked really, but all of them were clearly not part of the system store.
Kai muttered, "So he has two ways of selling... system items through the crystal, and some worldly items through his own trade."
He crouched slightly, scanning the displayed items.
Meanwhile, the Gene Trader’s hands were just waving his hands, arranging blades, tools, and odd accessories across the mantle.
As Kai’s eyes roamed across the mantle, he confirmed that they were all items that once belonged to the old world, things that could be rarely found in the A.I. Apocalypse.

There was a gas mask, a pair of protective goggles, a small bottle of perfume, an old laptop, packets of instant coffee powder, a mechanical wristwatch, a steel thermos, a folding knife, a digital camera, a set of cooking utensils, a box of preserved spices, a stack of vinyl music records, a pack of cigarettes, and a rolled scroll.
"Ahh... Wait... What’s that?" Kai muttered as he saw a grenade-like item.
Then, there was a note below it. Apparently, it was a small, cylindrical EMP grenade!
Furthermore, its casing was marked with faded military insignia.
As for the rolled scroll, tied with a strip of leather, it was actually a map based on the notes!

Kai couldn’t see the map inside, but curiosity gnawed at him. It was definitely a great item to have! Perhaps, the map had some notes about the locations of the shelters, the A.I. Cities, or even other Gene Traders!
But then his eyes caught something strange. Beside each item was a number scrawled on a small note.
Aside from the name of the item, there was a number attached to it ranging from 1,000 to 10,000
There was no label, no currency, no explanation. Just numbers.
Kai frowned. "What do these mean? Survivor Medals? Energy Cores? No... the prices are too high. Even the EMP grenade is marked at ten thousand."
As he stared, the Gene Trader finally noticed his interest. The cloaked figure raised a hand, and a system message appeared in front of Kai.
[ Trade Notice: Items outside the system store cannot be purchased with Survivor Medals or Energy Cores. ]
[ Requirement: Experience Points ]
Kai’s eyes widened. "Experience Points...?!"
He was stunned at this discovery!
Then, the Gene Trader lifted a small, glowing purple sphere.
Kai leaned closer as he studied it. After observing for a moment, he confirmed that its surface was swirling with faint specks of light, drifting like stars trapped inside glass.
It was mesmerizing!
"Fine... You can even take Experience Points. That’s... just incredible," Kai whispered as he felt a little bit helpless...
At this point, Kai was convinced the Gene Trader was an extension of the Apocalypse System, a living fragment of its will.
And then another thought struck him. Perhaps the reason the Gene Trader never spoke was deliberate. By remaining silent, it avoided the endless haggling and bargaining that came with human merchants!
Kai smirked to himself. "If this guy could talk, I’d probably have lowered the price by eighty percent already."
