chapters.title: Chapter 125: Taking Advantage
paragraphs: Kai smiled at their reaction as he also confirmed that he also got a bunch of experience points, and he even leveled up once!
[ +350 Experience Points. ]
[ +350 Experience Points. ]
[ You have leveled up! ]
[ +350 Experience Points. ]
The notifications continued for some time as he killed quite a lot.
Still, he was now Level 18!
Furthermore, even though he didn’t get a Skill Point, he realized that his Keen Sense had leveled up from Level 3 to Level 4.
The improvement he got from leveling up wasn’t that much, but he knew that the Level 20 milestone would be huge, just like when he reached Level 10.
"Tomorrow... I should reach Level 20." Kai muttered as he looked around.
The Survivors stood among the corpses, breathing heavily. They seemed exhausted, but it seemed that they also realized that they had gotten stronger.
Kai raised his hand. "Rest. That’s the first batch done."
Claire nodded, signaling her squad to lower their weapons.
Farrah and Alfie slumped against the broken wall of a mausoleum. Although they leveled up and their Health and Spirit Points recovered, their stamina didn’t reset...
It had been their first real fight against Mutants, and it felt different fighting against Sentinels.
In any case, there was nothing to loot. The Mutants carried no weapons, no valuables, nothing useful. They were simply husks of flesh, designed to kill.
The group returned to the armored cars. Water bottles were passed around, and everyone drank greedily.
The cool liquid soothed their throats, and for a moment, they all relaxed.
Kai didn’t waste time. "We need to deal with the bodies."
Claire agreed. "If we leave them, the stench will attract more trouble. And besides... It’s safer to make sure they don’t rise again."
"They’re not Zombies but okay... Haha..." Kai laughed as he knew that these mutants were already dead after they gave out Experience Points.
Soon, the team dragged the corpses into piles. Torches and fuel were brought out, and soon flames roared to life.
Just like that, the Mutants burned easily, their flesh swiftly crumbled into ash...
Farrah frowned. "Strange... fire barely touched them when they were alive. But now, they burn like dry wood."
She actually tried using fire against them a while ago, but it didn’t work. However, what she was seeing now was different.
Kai smiled as he also had a similar reaction before.
"Yes... Alive, they resist fire. Dead, they’re fragile. Another mystery of this apocalypse."
"At least cleanup’s easy." Alfie muttered.
After it was all settled, Kai decided that it was enough.
"We’ll stop here. We’ve learned enough. This trap can be exploited. Tomorrow, we’ll return with more."
Claire smirked. "Agreed. Better to come back fresh."
The next day, the cemetery became a battlefield once again. This time, Kai brought all the Foreign Survivors.
Aside from himself, there were Claire, Wallace, Victor, and Ralph from Haven‐45. They were all high-level Survivors and had experienced a lot of battles.
From Haven‐15 came Terrence, Aurora, and Jonas. They weren’t really combat-type Survivors like many others, but with the weapons Kai could provide, they had no issues joining the team.
It was the same with Elena and Marissa from Haven‐40. They had been rescued not long ago, and though their talents leaned more toward support than direct combat, Kai wanted them here.
They needed to level up faster, to gain Gene Skills and Survivor Medals. If they became stronger, they could pay him back and contribute more to him and the group itself.
Finally, there were Farrah and Alfie from Haven‐62, the newest additions to Kai’s ranks. They had only just joined, but their performance in the first wave was truly decent.
With their Spirit Knight and Gladiator Talent, they were already considered core members!
Kai looked over the assembled group and nodded.
"Today, we exploit the trap again. Stick to the plan..."
The Survivors nodded. They understood.
Kai wasn’t forcing anyone.
He had simply offered them to take advantage of this trap with him.
To assist them, he offered one Survivor Medal for fifty bullets and basic gear.
Those who couldn’t pay now would owe him later.
Since Kai was the only one who could provide ammunition, they accepted the deal without hesitation. After all, they didn’t mind taking a loan!
Thanks to this, Kai had already collected more Medals, strengthening his position even further.
Of course, Kai didn’t rush them into another fight immediately. Instead, he raised his hand and gave clear instructions.
"Set the traps properly... I don’t want those Mutants charging straight at us. Hold the line with traps first."

The Survivors moved quickly. Under Kai’s orders, they began fortifying the cemetery. Wooden pikes were hammered into the ground, angled outward to pierce anything that tried to rush them. Metal scraps were piled into pointed barricades. There were sharp edges ready to tear into flesh.
Soon, even barbed wire collected from the junkyard was stretched across choke points, forcing the Mutants to slow down or bleed themselves trying to push through.
Pitfalls were also dug hastily, covered with loose planks and dirt, waiting to swallow the careless.
It didn’t end there, ropes from the Survival Gift Pack were tied low across the ground, ready to trip the creatures while charging...
Even the broken tombstones were dragged into position, forming crude barriers to funnel the enemy into kill zones.
Kai oversaw everything and felt satisfied.
It felt much better than yesterday.
"Good. Keep the pikes close to the front. Barbed wire on the flanks. Pitfalls behind the smoke line..."
Claire and Ralph’s squad worked efficiently as they could already imagine what kind of battle they were about to face... They knew what areas were lacking and had to adjust them.

Meanwhile, Farrah and Alfie followed instructions carefully as they helped secure the traps. Elena and Marissa, though not combat‐types, carried supplies and assisted with the setup, determined to contribute.
Within minutes, the cemetery looked different. It wasn’t just a graveyard anymore! It was a battlefield prepared for slaughter.
Kai was finally satisfied with their preparations and nodded.
"Alright. Defenses are ready. Claire, send someone in."

Soon, even barbed wire collected from the junkyard was stretched across choke points, forcing the Mutants to slow down or bleed themselves trying to push through.
Pitfalls were also dug hastily, covered with loose planks and dirt, waiting to swallow the careless.
It didn’t end there, ropes from the Survival Gift Pack were tied low across the ground, ready to trip the creatures while charging...
Even the broken tombstones were dragged into position, forming crude barriers to funnel the enemy into kill zones.
Kai oversaw everything and felt satisfied.
It felt much better than yesterday.
"Good.
Keep the pikes close to the front.
Barbed wire on the flanks.
Pitfalls behind the smoke line..."
Claire and Ralph’s squad worked efficiently as they could already imagine what kind of battle they were about to face...
They knew what areas were lacking and had to adjust them.
Meanwhile, Farrah and Alfie followed instructions carefully as they helped secure the traps.
Elena and Marissa, though not combat‐types, carried supplies and assisted with the setup, determined to contribute.
Within minutes, the cemetery looked different.
It wasn’t just a graveyard anymore!
It was a battlefield prepared for slaughter.
Kai was finally satisfied with their preparations and nodded.
"Alright.
Defenses are ready.
Claire, send someone in."

chapters.title: Chapter 126: The Limit
paragraphs: Under Kai’s orders, Claire directed one of the local Survivors to step into the mausoleum’s threshold once again.
"Be careful... Run immediately." She reminded.
"Yes!"
The moment the man crossed the boundary, the ground trembled.
It was similar to what had happened before.
A rumble shook the cemetery, louder than yesterday.
Perhaps the trap detected that there were more of them right now, so it summoned more mutants!
Just like that, larger cracks split the pavement, and another hidden tunnels burst open.
Soon, the Mutants came!
At first, there were only dozens of them charging forward as they clawed their way out of hidden tunnels and collapsing crypts.
Some burst from beneath broken pavement, others from shattered tombs.
They were everywhere!
Kai’s voice rang out. "Positions! Do not advance! Stay within the lines!"
The Mutants charged, but this time the defenses were waiting.
The first batch of the mutants impaled themselves on the wooden pikes... They could only shriek as the sharpened stakes pierced their torsos.
Others stumbled into the barbed wire stretched across the flanks... They could only thrash wildly to try and escape, but by doing so, the steel only tore into their flesh and slowed their advance.
"Good!" Kai muttered in satisfaction, seeing how effective it was.
Then, he saw another group rush forward blindly, only to fall into the hastily dug pitfalls. Needless to say, they were skewered by the sharpened stakes hidden inside.
Thud! Thud! Thud!

Soon, those ropes that were tied low across the ground tripped more of them, sending the creatures sprawling face‐first into the dirt, where they were stomped on by the other mutants behind them, essentially killing them in the process.
Even the broken tombstones served their purpose, funneling the Mutants into narrow kill zones where revolvers fired in controlled bursts.
Bang! Bang! Bang!

Everyone emptied their revolvers first before switching to close combat. After all, unless it was point-blank range, only Ralph and Atom had the precision to shoot without risking friendly fire in the chaos.
Just like that, Kai confirmed that they were not losing or overwhelmed by the mutants!
They could do this!
He watched as Farrah and Alfie fought side by side again. They looked more confident than yesterday!
Alfie fired his revolver, dropping a Mutant mid‐charge. Then, Farrah hurled a smoke grenade, obscuring their flank and forcing enemies into the barbed wire.
They were really aware of their surroundings.
Then, Kai saw Atom advance toward their weakest area like a juggernaut... Even just by using a thick and dull sword, the A-Grade Sentinel could easily smash through enemies.
’Good... You can decide what area to support...’Kai thought as his command to Atom a while ago was to support their weakest coverage.
It seemed that Atom could really analyze the battlefield well.
Meanwhile, Wallace and Victor coordinated their attacks, cutting down the mutants that tried to leap over the barricades.

Wallace had a Superior-Rank Talent called Iron Stamina. Then, he also had Swift Stride, a passive Gene Skill, which allowed him to move faster... Because of that, he partnered with Victor, who didn’t have combat skills, to ensure his safety and that he could help the man level up faster.
There were also Aurora and Jonas, who were just behind Atom.
Sometimes, Atom would only cut off the mutant’s limbs, and so, the two of them would always work together to eliminate these stragglers.
Elena and Marissa also fought fiercely, striking down any Mutant that managed to slip past the defenses.
The battle was chaos, but it was controlled chaos in Kai’s opinion...
Furthermore, every kill brought the familiar chime of the system.
[ +350 Experience Points. ]
[ +350 Experience Points. ]
[ +350 Experience Points. ]
The notifications echoed in their minds, fueling their desire to kill all the mutants!
Farrah laughed breathlessly as she reloaded. "So many points! This is insane!"
Alfie grinned as well. "Keep them coming!"
"This is better than I imagined. We could level faster than ever." Claire added that she also felt really happy with their current progress.
Without a doubt, the Leaderboard would be filled with their names soon!
However, at this time, Kai’s focus was actually on both Sera and Althea.
These two lucky women, who managed to obtain and bind Gene Weapons within their bodies, were doing really well.
Their short swords and daggers were incredibly sharp, and they could tear through the mutant’s body like slicing bread!
It was too sharp!
’I should check their status again after this...’Kai thought.
Gradually, the Mutants began to thin. Their numbers dwindled, and their attacks soon slowed.
At this point, the cemetery was already filled with smoke, blood, and ash.
Thud!
Finally, the last mutant was slain, and silence fell once more.
"We’re done!"
They had succeeded! They eliminated the swarm of mutants!
With just less than fifty people on their side, they had killed more than five hundred mutants, suffering only two casualties and injuries...
The two casualties weren’t even supposed to happen.
They were members of the Assault Team B who had stepped too far forward, thinking they could kill more mutants...
Kai shook his head as he really had to instill discipline in these guys later.
Meanwhile, Aurora looked at her bloodied clothes before turning her attention to the notifications...
"That... was worth it. Look at the points we gained."
Farrah and Alfie exchanged a glance and agreed. They had also leveled up this time.
"We’re also in the leaderboard now!"
Just like that, after a short celebration, the Survivors rested and followed the same routine as before.
The corpses were dragged into piles, torches lit, and soon the flames consumed the Mutants until nothing but ash remained.
Once cleanup was finished, Kai ordered another round of defenses to be set... fresh pikes, barbed wire, pitfalls, and barricades were arranged across the cemetery.
Three hours later, they triggered the trap again.
The ground shook, and more than five hundred Mutants were eliminated in this second attempt, and this time, no casualties on their side!
However, they had surely emptied their ammunition this time.
But just as the group celebrated its progress, someone suddenly noticed something strange.
The Gene Trader... had disappeared!

chapters.title: Chapter 127: Reaching the Milestone
paragraphs: "He... He’s gone! The Gene Trader is not here anymore!"
As the Survivors rested and checked their notifications, someone suddenly realized the Gene Trader had disappeared!
This was a blunder.
Kai’s expression changed as he immediately gave a command. "Search the area. Check the mausoleum, the tunnels, even the crypts. Don’t leave a stone unturned."
Claire’s squad moved quickly, spreading out across the cemetery.

Wallace and Victor checked the collapsed tombs, Aurora and Jonas scouted the tunnels, while Elena and Marissa searched the mausoleum itself. Farrah and Alfie even climbed onto broken rooftops to scan the surroundings.
But after nearly an hour, they had to admit defeat...
The Gene Trader had vanished without a trace.
Kai stood silently as he tried to make sense of the situation.
In the end, he had suspected that there was a limit.
It seemed that the system wouldn’t allow Survivors to abuse the trap forever. This disappearance was the solution... a safeguard against endless farming.
Finally, Kai exhaled and accepted it.
"Enough. He’s gone. We’ve pushed the trap as far as we could. The system must have set a limit, and now we know what happens when it’s crossed."
The others nodded reluctantly.
They already guessed as much.
They had gained much, but the opportunity was gone.
Still, Kai wasn’t discouraged.
He checked his own status and smiled faintly. He had already reached Level 19. Unfortunately, the next milestone required more.
To reach Level 20, he would need to absorb another batch of C‐Grade Energy Cores. Thankfully, he had plenty stored.
Kai clenched his fist. "Even without the Trader, we’ve grown stronger. Level 20 is within reach. This was worth it."
The Survivors looked at him, reassured by his calm acceptance.
They had also leveled up, and even if they didn’t reach Level 19 like Kai, they still managed to reach Level 14, and some of them even reached Level 15!
The Gene Trader was gone, but they knew that it wouldn’t be long before they could find another Gene Trader.
As a matter of fact, Kai was aware of the location of another Trader. It was the one found by Russel, Dylan, and Gabby within the ruined industrial zone.
Since the matter was settled, the Survivors finally left the cemetery and returned to New Haven‐45 Shelter.
The atmosphere was calmer now, though everyone still felt a little concerned about the disappearance of the Gene Trader.

Nonetheless, inside his quarters, Kai sat down and opened his inventory. His eyes fell on the crystal‐like object. Although most of the Energy Cores they had collected from the Tyrants were in the vault of the shelter, Kai had one stored in his Inventory.
It was specifically for this moment!
[ Tyrant Energy Core (C) ]
[ Origin: Not from the A.I. Rebel forces of this world, but from the A.I. Civilization that seeded and influenced its artificial intelligences. ]

[ Description: A condensed energy source harvested from a C‐Grade Mechanical Tyrant. Unlike ordinary Energy Cells, this core also contains energy that can push organic hosts beyond their natural limits. ]
[ Requirement: Can only be absorbed by Survivors with a Physique Rating of D or higher. ]
[ Effect: Upon absorption, the Energy Core will permanently enhance the host’s body, unlocking the potential to surpass human limits and reach Level 20 ]
[ Warning: Absorption is irreversible. Failure to meet requirements may result in fatal overload. ]
Kai gently nodded after seeing it once again...
When he saw this for the first time, he knew that it would give him a huge surprise if he reached the limit...
Now, he had already reached Level 19, and it was finally time to reach this level!
"Level 20... it’s time."
He held the Tyrant Core firmly.
[ Energy Core absorption initiated... ]
[ Synchronizing with host physiology... ]
A surge of power coursed through his body. It felt warm, but it was starting to settle within his body...
Soon, he felt his physique improve, and numerous notifications followed!
As expected, the Level 20 was a huge milestone!
[ Absorption complete. ]
[ You have leveled up! ]
[ Level: 20 ]
[ Health Points +100 ]
[ Spirit Points +5 ]
[ Physique Rating has improved! ]
[ New Gene Skill Awakened! ]
The system didn’t stop there.
[ Congratulations! You are the first Survivor to reach Level 20. ]
[ You have received a new Title: Guardian ]
[ Your Survivor Title has been upgraded to Skilled Survivor. ]
[ Reward: Superior Gene Skill Awakening Token +1 ]
[ Reward: Survivor Medal +5, Skill Point +2 ]
Kai’s eyes widened as more lines appeared.
"This is awesome..."
His Survivor Title had finally been upgraded, and he even gained a new one!
Furthermore, he even managed to obtain a Superior Gene Skill Awakening Token! Just from its name, he felt that it was a lot better than the Gene Trader’s Low-Grade or Mid-Grade Gene Skill Crystal.
It didn’t matter whether it would give him passive or active Gene Skill, it would definitely be amazing!
And then, something unexpected appeared.
[ New Feature Activated: World Chat ]
[ Description: Survivors who reach Level 20 gain access to the World Chat system. Communicate across shelters and territories. ]
[ Limit: 3 messages per day. ]
[ Warning: Messages are visible to all Level 20 Survivors worldwide. Use wisely. ]
[ Your achievement has been broadcast to the World Chat. ]
The system that he could use was also being upgraded!
Kai looked at the system message, stunned. He didn’t expect such an update to happen.
"Broadcast?"
He was the first to reach this milestone, and now, it has been announced in the World Chat!
"Interesting system feature. World Chat... so now, Survivors can connect beyond their shelters. This changes everything."
The notifications faded, leaving Kai with a sense of accomplishment. He had crossed the threshold, and the system had acknowledged it...
In any case, it was time to check the Gene Skill he had awakened!
[ New Passive Gene Skill Activated! ]
[ Skill: Bronze Skin (Level 0) ]
[ Description: The user’s epidermis hardens slightly, reducing incoming physical damage by 8%. Provides minor resistance against cuts, bruises, and blunt force. ]
[ Note: Passive skills cannot be deactivated. Leveling requires Gene Skill Points. ]
"Ohhhhh... Finally! A defensive Gene Skill!" This was definitely worth a celebration!
Even if it wasn’t an Active Skill, he’d take it!

chapters.title: Chapter 128: New Titles and Skills
paragraphs: Kai flexed his hand and immediately felt the change.
His skin was tougher and felt denser. He tapped his forearm a few times, listening to the dull thud instead of the usual soft sound. Even at Level 0, the Gene Skill was still awakened!
"I guess it’s working," he muttered.
After feeling satisfied, he decided not to use his Skill points yet. He decided to check the system’s new feature...the World Chat.
As expected, the interface was empty. There was only one message displayed, the broadcast announcement.
[ Announcement: ]
[ Congratulations! Survivor Kai has become the FIRST to reach Level 20! ]
The same message was then repeated two more times.
Kai stared at it for a moment. He couldn’t help but smile seeing this.
Curious about how this works, he tried typing a message.
[ Kai: I am here first. ]
The words appeared instantly in the chat window.
Of course, there was no reply. He was the only Level 20 Survivor in existence. But it didn’t matter... he had tested the feature, and it worked.
Satisfied, Kai closed the chat and turned his attention to his upgraded titles.
First, he recalled the Survivor Title he had carried until now...
[ Title: Survivor ]
[ Title Effect: Satiety decreases more slowly. Survivors can endure longer without food before hunger penalties occur. ]
It had been a huge help all this time for obvious reasons. Now that it was upgraded, Kai believed that it would help him even more.
And as expected, it didn’t disappoint!
[ Title: Skilled Survivor ]

[ Title Effect: Hunger penalties take longer to manifest, stamina recovers more steadily after exertion, and fatigue resistance is noticeably improved with slight resistance against environmental hazards such as mild toxins, spoiled food, and contaminated water. ]
Kai nodded. "That’s a solid improvement. Less fatigue... and even resistance to terrible food and water."
Then, he checked the second title he had received... The one that came with his achievement.
[ Title: Guardian ]
[ Title Effect: Resilience against physical damage is greatly increased. The body endures heavy blows more effectively, pain tolerance is heightened, and stamina recovers faster. ]
Kai’s eyes lingered on the new title. He flexed his arm again, then clenched his fist, feeling the difference.
His body wasn’t just tougher... He somehow felt unstoppable with this!
’Good... Pain tolerance has improved...’
A faint grin crossed his face. "Guardian... this is nice. I hope this gets upgraded, too."
He finally lay on his bed to rest.
He may not be able to use the same trick to level up faster again, but he had already achieved his goal...
He was truly ahead of the other Survivors this time!
Kai exhaled slowly, as he imagined the future...
The World Chat was empty now, but it wouldn’t stay that way forever. Once others reached Level 20, the silence would break, and the channel would grow lively with voices from across the world.
He couldn’t help but feel a little excited about that. After, he’d be able to connect to other people, and perhaps, he could even find someone he knew!
In any case, after relaxing for some time, Kai finally turned his attention to another reward he had just obtained.
It was the Superior Gene Skill Awakening Token.
He checked it in his inventory. The item appeared as a coin, and it had intricate markings. Curious, Kai took it out.
Immediately, a notification appeared.
[ Item detected: Superior Gene Skill Awakening Token ]
[ Activate? ]
Kai didn’t hesitate. "Activate."
[ Token activation initiated... ]
[ Processing... ]
Instead of granting him a random skill, the system surprised him.
[ Selection unlocked. Choose one Gene Skill. ]
[ Four options available: ]
Two Active Gene Skills. Two Passive Gene Skills.
Kai’s eyes widened. "A choice...?"
He didn’t expect this at all.
He then scrolled through the list, reading them carefully.
[ Active Gene Skill: Spark Burst ]
[ Description: Release a sudden surge of fire energy, damaging enemies in close range. ]
[ Active Gene Skill: Specter Step ]
[ Description: Briefly distort movement, allowing the user to evade attacks or reposition instantly. ]
[ Passive Gene Skill: Stone Skin ]
[ Description: Skin density increases, granting natural resistance against slashing and piercing damage. ]
[ Passive Gene Skill: Strong Instinct ]
[ Description: Heightened awareness of surroundings. Reaction speed improves when danger approaches. ]
Kai frowned slightly.
They weren’t tailored to him at all, they were completely terrible.
The Stone Skin was bad since he had just learned the Bronze Skin. It was the same for Strong Instinct since he already had Keen Sense.
Still, he liked how it went.
"So that’s how it works... Superior Token doesn’t adapt to me. It just gives a pool of choices."
Nonetheless, Kai didn’t think too much and made a swift decision.
Without a doubt, he selected the Specter Step!
After all, he already had Spirit Pulse, so he felt that the Spark Burst was too much.
As soon as Kai made his choice, the system responded instantly.
[ Gene Skill Selected: Specter Step ]
[ Skill Type: Active ]
[ Description: Distort movement for a brief moment, allowing the user to evade incoming attacks or reposition instantly. The body flickers between two points, leaving behind a faint afterimage.
Spirit Point Cost: 20
Cooldown: 15 seconds ]
Kai’s eyes lit up as the full description appeared in front of him...
"So it’s an evasive skill... perfect."
He stood up from his bed, stretching his arms before focusing. With a thought, he activated the skill.
For a split second, his vision blurred. His body moved so fast, and he felt himself shift sideways.
Thud.
Soon, he reappeared a few meters away with a faint Spirit energy trailing behind.
’That’s 20 SP already...’
The sensation was strange... He felt like his body had skipped a beat in reality. Still, it was an awesome feeling!
Kai couldn’t help but feel excited as he realized how good it was!
"That... was fast."
He tried again after the 15 seconds had passed, this time aiming toward the door. His body distorted, and in an instant, he was standing right in front of it
Furthermore, he saw the afterimage linger for a heartbeat before fading!
The drain on his Spirit Points was noticeable, but not overwhelming.
"This can actually work..." Kai muttered... He also had an idea on how to take advantage of this skill!

His skin was tougher and felt denser.
He tapped his forearm a few times, listening to the dull thud instead of the usual soft sound.
Even at Level 0, the Gene Skill was still awakened!
"I guess it’s working," he muttered.
After feeling satisfied, he decided not to use his Skill points yet.
He decided to check the system’s new feature...the World Chat.
As expected, the interface was empty.
There was only one message displayed, the broadcast announcement.
[ Announcement: ]
[ Congratulations!
Survivor Kai has become the FIRST to reach Level 20! ]
The same message was then repeated two more times.
Kai stared at it for a moment.
He couldn’t help but smile seeing this.
Curious about how this works, he tried typing a message.
[ Kai: I am here first. ]
The words appeared instantly in the chat window.
Of course, there was no reply.
He was the only Level 20 Survivor in existence.
But it didn’t matter... he had tested the feature, and it worked.
Satisfied, Kai closed the chat and turned his attention to his upgraded titles.
First, he recalled the Survivor Title he had carried until now...
[ Title: Survivor ]
[ Title Effect: Satiety decreases more slowly.
Survivors can endure longer without food before hunger penalties occur. ]
It had been a huge help all this time for obvious reasons.
Now that it was upgraded, Kai believed that it would help him even more.
And as expected, it didn’t disappoint!
[ Title: Skilled Survivor ]

[ Title Effect: Hunger penalties take longer to manifest, stamina recovers more steadily after exertion, and fatigue resistance is noticeably improved with slight resistance against environmental hazards such as mild toxins, spoiled food, and contaminated water. ]
Kai nodded.
"That’s a solid improvement.
Less fatigue... and even resistance to terrible food and water."
Then, he checked the second title he had received...
The one that came with his achievement.
[ Title: Guardian ]
[ Title Effect: Resilience against physical damage is greatly increased.
The body endures heavy blows more effectively, pain tolerance is heightened, and stamina recovers faster. ]
Kai’s eyes lingered on the new title.
He flexed his arm again, then clenched his fist, feeling the difference.
His body wasn’t just tougher...
He somehow felt unstoppable with this!
’Good...
Pain tolerance has improved...’
A faint grin crossed his face.
"Guardian... this is nice.
I hope this gets upgraded, too."
He finally lay on his bed to rest.
He may not be able to use the same trick to level up faster again, but he had already achieved his goal...
He was truly ahead of the other Survivors this time!
Kai exhaled slowly, as he imagined the future...
The World Chat was empty now, but it wouldn’t stay that way forever.
Once others reached Level 20, the silence would break, and the channel would grow lively with voices from across the world.
He couldn’t help but feel a little excited about that.
After, he’d be able to connect to other people, and perhaps, he could even find someone he knew!
In any case, after relaxing for some time, Kai finally turned his attention to another reward he had just obtained.

He checked it in his inventory.

Immediately, a notification appeared.

[ Activate? ]
Kai didn’t hesitate.
"Activate."

Choose one Gene Skill. ]

[ Description: Skin density increases, granting natural resistance against slashing and piercing damage. ]

chapters.title: Chapter 129: The End of the Global Event
paragraphs: For the remaining days of the Global Event, Kai and the rest of the team focused on staying within the shelter, venturing out only when necessary.
Whenever Field Tyrants drew too close, they coordinated swift hunts to drive them back. They couldn’t just let their shelter get run over by this large mechanized army after all.
On the sixth day, the ground trembled as another Tyrant approached.
Kai stood at the shelter gate, ready to deal with this...
’This time... I need to see how strong I am at Level 20. Atom will just be a support for now.’

"Everyone... It’s coming closer. Claire, Ralph... get your squads ready. Farrah, Alfie... you’re with me. Atom will deal with the Spyder Units hiding from afar. Let’s focus on the Tyrant and Sentinels!"
Claire adjusted her gloves and nodded. "Understood. We’ll take the left flank."
"We’re going right then..." Ralph added.
Soon, everyone made their move.
The battle began as the Tyrant’s Sentinel Escorts charged forward.
Thankfully, they do not have plasma rifles with them. They were only carrying blades, and that wouldn’t be enough to win against them.
’I guess you’re also running out of energy cells or ammunition for your rifles, huh...’Kai thought as he knew that this was the best-case scenario.
Kai moved ahead as he activated Specter Step. His form blurred, reappearing behind the nearest Sentinel.
Then, he triggered Spirit Pulse by spending 70 SP points!
"Take this..."
Boom!
The skilled unleashing of a wave of energy that blasted the mechanical unit forward...
Farrah followed with her finishing blow!
Thud!
The Sentinel’s head was cut off mid-air!
"One down!"
Then, her Spirit Knight aura boosted her strength, and with just a wave of her blade, he slashed two Sentinels trying to get closer to Kai.
Alfie also charged forward... He was supposedly one of the tanks or damage dealer because of his Gladiator Talent, but his speed made him late!
Nonetheless, Gladiator talent amplified his strength and damage, so as long as he got a clean hit, he was confident to win against anyone.
Bam!
He slammed his hatchet into a Sentinel’s chest, and sparks flew everywhere... "Come on, you tin can!"
Claire also made her move against the Tyrant, and as she landed a thunderous punch on its armor. She realized that she had at least made a small dent.
"It’s tough... but not invincible..." She muttered as she just used a Gene Skill just now.
Soon, Ralph’s revolvers continued firing, eliminating all the Sentinels around the Tyrant.

His sharpshooter talent made every shot precise, piercing weak points in the escorts’ armors... Then, with his new Gene Skill, he didn’t even have any issue shooting with his left and right hands at the same time!
Just like that, the battle continued for some time, and of course, they all used their various Gene Skills in the process. Indeed, it wasn’t just Kai who had awakened new Gene Skills!
They were all eager to try their new Gene Skills!
Finally, after a grueling fight, the Tyrant finally collapsed, with its massive body shaking the ground.
[ Enemy Unit Destroyed: Field Tyrant (C) ]
[ Experience Points distributed among all participants. ]
The system notifications chimed in their minds, awarding experience points, and those who were lucky even managed to level up.

"Whew... It’s a good thing I watched Atom how to fight... Targeting those weak points is really important." Kai muttered as he confirmed that he was left with almost zero Spirit Points during that battle. Thankfully, he was able to level up, so his Health and Spirit Points had been refilled already.
Still, by the eighth day, the team had grown more confident. Survivor Medals flowed steadily from their hunts, and Kai ensured they were traded wisely.
Farrah examined her new goggles. "The bullets and these goggles were worth every Medal. I can see the Spyders and hunt them at night before they even move."
Kai smiled faintly after hearing this. "Good. We’ll need every edge we can get."
"Stay alert. The event’s almost over, but the Mech Army won’t stop until the countdown ends."
On the final day, the tension was intense.
They had just fought two more Tyrants...
The shelter residents worked tirelessly, reinforcing barricades and preparing supplies.
One of the Haven‐62 locals muttered nervously, "Do we really have to fight again? Haven’t we done enough?"
Alfie placed a hand on his shoulder. "Don’t give up... After this, I’m sure we will be rewarded well... Every battle we win keeps this shelter safe."
Farrah added firmly, "And every Medal we earn makes us stronger. Don’t forget that."
Alfie grinned...
Claire raised her voice to her squad. "Final day. Let’s show them what our shelter can do."
The team moved out one last time.
They couldn’t just wait until their shelter got targeted again. Using their shelter as a battlefield was already too much!
It was already battered at this point, so they had to bring the battle elsewhere...
Of course, during this time, they even used plenty of smoke grenades to blind the enemy and hide their shelter while they were out.
Outside the shelter, they also hunted several more Field Tyrants that had suddenly become more active for some reason.
Soon after, the system notification appeared before them all...
"It’s done!!!" Alfie shouted as he saw the message he had been waiting for!
[ Global Event: Field Tyrant Hunt Concluded ]
[ Hostile Operation Terminated ]
[ Objective Complete: Survivors have endured and resisted the mechanical Field Boss deployment across the continent. ]
[ Deployment Ceased: Field Tyrants, Sentinel Escorts, and Spyder Rangers have withdrawn from active patrol zones. ]
[ Rewards Distributed: Experience Points, Rare Loot Drops, Survivor’s Medals, Gene Enhancement Materials, and additional bonuses have been allocated. ]
[ Special Notice: Gene Traders will remain active for a limited time to exchange Survivor’s Medals for rare genetic resources. ]
[ Special Reward: Top 10 Performers ]
[ Survivors with the highest number of Field Tyrant eliminations have been granted Superior Gene Skill Awakening Tokens, Exclusive Title Upgrades, and Special Material Treasure Chest. ]

chapters.title: Chapter 130: The Event Rewards
paragraphs: Just a few moments ago, within New Haven‐45, the atmosphere had become really lively.
Victor was in his simple workshop when it happened. Specifically, he was tinkering with a new trap using his Mechanic Talent when the glowing text appeared before his eyes.
He froze, then laughed.
"Hah! Finally! It’s over... and we actually made it. Guess I can finish this trap tomorrow."
Nearby, Ralph and Claire had just finished dismantling a Sentinel Unit...
"Not bad for the last fight."
Ralph holstered his revolvers and nodded. "Not bad at all. I hope I get rewarded with a beer or something."
Claire chuckled. "That’s impossible. Where can we even get a beer?"
Meanwhile, on the walls of the shelter, Wallace and Jonas slumped against the battlements, exhausted. For ten days, they had stayed here almost without rest, and now the silence felt relaxing...
Jonas muttered, "I can’t believe we can finally breathe."
Wallace nodded as he closed his eyes. "We held... that’s all that matters."
As he said this, he immediately went to check the rewards.

Then, in the gardens of the shelter, Aurora, Elena, and Marissa hugged each other tightly. They had spent most of their time tending crops, keeping insects away, and ensuring water supplies didn’t fail.
Their work had kept the shelter fed, and now they could finally relax.
Aurora whispered, "We did it... the event is over."
Elena smiled through tears and nodded. "Finally..."
Marissa also laughed softly. "Check the rewards immediately..."
Just like what the notification said, the rewards had been distributed!
’So I made it into the top ten... I guess that’s not surprising...’Kai muttered as he focused on his system...
Since he was the first to reach Level 20, it means that he had really performed well in this event.
Soon, the rewards flowed into his inventory one by one.
[ Event Rewards: +12,000 EXP, Survivor’s Medals x7, Skill Points +2
[ Additional Rewards: Mixed Ammunition Crates x5, MRE Boxes x5, Advanced Signal Jammer x2, Mutagenic Gene Enhancement Serum x10, Rapid Recovery Pill x5
[ Bonus Item: Gene Trader’s 50% Discount Voucher (valid for 7 days) ]
Kai felt his level surge upward, his Health and Spirit Points refilling instantly.
’Ohhh... I leveled up...’ Kai mused as he confirmed it with another notification from the system.
[ You have leveled up! ]
He didn’t think too much of it at the moment as he focused on the rewards!
The crates, MRE boxes, and even the jammer! They were all incredibly precious.
As for the Mutagenic Serum, it wasn’t that great. However, Kai had a feeling that it was actually perfect for him.
’Alright... I really hope we find a nearby Gene Trader.’ Kai thought...
Then another notification came... This time, it was for the top 10 Performer Rewards!
[ Special Reward: Superior Gene Skill Awakening Token x1, Exclusive Title Upgrade Chance x1, Special Material Treasure Chest x3, Gene Weapon ( Low-Grade) x1 ]
’So I really did make it into the top ten...’Kai thought as he checked the rewards.

He was familiar with the Skill Awakening Token, but the Title Upgrade Chance was new. Still, from its name, he could guess that he could select one of his Titles and upgrade them to their higher version.
In any case, he opened his inventory and froze.
Among the rewards sat a block of silver metal...
Kai immediately guessed that it was the Gene Weapon. It was quite similar to the item Sera and Althea described.
As he tapped the icon in his inventory, he was able to get some information about it.
[ Gene Weapon ( Low-Grade ) ]
[ Instruction: Touch to initiate genetic binding. The weapon will adapt to the host’s physique. ]
Kai clenched his fist as he saw it...
’Once I touch it, it’ll bind permanently... and become mine. Very interesting. I wonder if the other nine got the same reward.’
For now, he left it there...
’Since it adapts to my physique... I might as well try it when my physique gets better... When the time comes, I’ll awaken it.’
Around him, the shelter erupted in cheers as others celebrated their own rewards.
Without a doubt, these people obtained amazing items from the system as well. Perhaps, he’d be able to see a variety of Gene Skills from Claire and the others later.
But for now, Kai focused as his interface lit up with a new series of messages!
He had been expecting this... After all, his actions during the ten‐day siege had gone beyond the standard objectives, and it was something he had seen after the last Global Event...
[ Hidden Quests Completed! ]
Indeed! Kai had completed a few Hidden Quests.
As a matter of fact, he had been waiting for the rewards coming from these Hidden Quests since he knew that they would provide Survivor Medals!
[ Shelter Defender: Prevented your shelter from collapsing despite repeated Tyrant assaults.
Reward: +3,000 EXP, Survivor’s Medal x2 ]
[ Coordinated Hunt: Eliminate at least 5 Field Tyrants with team participation.
Reward: +2,500 EXP, Survivor’s Medal x1 ]
[ Tactical Resource Management: Be the first Survivor to conduct a transaction with a Gene Trader during the Event.
Reward: +2,000 EXP, Survivor’s Medal x1 ]
[ Vanguard Test: Eliminate a Tyrant with the highest participation rate without taking any damage or injuries
Reward: +3,500 EXP, Survivor’s Medal x2, Rare Material Treasure Chest x1 ]
[ Total Hidden Quest Rewards: +11,000 EXP, Survivor’s Medals x6, Rare Material Treasure Chest x1 ]
Kai exhaled slowly, satisfied with the additional rewards.
’So the system really does track everything... even the risks I took. Good. This will push me further ahead.’
Then, as the celebrations spread, another set of messages appeared in front of the Foreign Survivors.
[ Global Event Cycle Update ]
[ Next Global Event will begin in 12 days, coinciding with the end of the month. ]
[ Ranking Rewards: Survivors listed on the leaderboard will receive their ranking rewards at that time. ]
[ Warning: Even during the 12‐day interval, the A.I. Army remains active. Hostile patrols will continue to hunt humans across the continent. Survivors are advised to remain vigilant. ]

[ Vanguard Test: Eliminate a Tyrant with the highest participation rate without taking any damage or injuries
Reward: +3,500 EXP, Survivor’s Medal x2, Rare Material Treasure Chest x1 ]
[ Total Hidden Quest Rewards: +11,000 EXP, Survivor’s Medals x6, Rare Material Treasure Chest x1 ]
Kai exhaled slowly, satisfied with the additional rewards.
’So the system really does track everything... even the risks I took.
Good.
This will push me further ahead.’
Then, as the celebrations spread, another set of messages appeared in front of the Foreign Survivors.
[ Global Event Cycle Update ]
[ Next Global Event will begin in 12 days, coinciding with the end of the month. ]
[ Ranking Rewards: Survivors listed on the leaderboard will receive their ranking rewards at that time. ]
[ Warning: Even during the 12‐day interval, the A.I.
Army remains active.
Hostile patrols will continue to hunt humans across the continent.
Survivors are advised to remain vigilant. ]

chapters.title: Chapter 131: The MREs and New Rewards
paragraphs: Outside, Kai could hear the shelter erupting in laughter and chatter.
Some of the Foreign Survivors had even torn open their MRE boxes already. Curiosity definitely outweighs exhaustion.
They didn’t want to rest, they wanted to see the rewards given to them by the system!
"There’s Beef ravioli here! Not bad at all," someone exclaimed.
Another groaned. "Ugh, chili and macaroni? I hate this... Can someone do a trade for this MRE? This one isn’t that bad, but it’s not really my type of food."
"Hey, don’t complain. At least it’s warm food. Oh... I got Southwest beef and black beans... this one’s actually decent."
"Chicken chunks here. Dry as hell, but better than nothing."
The comments bounced around. There was a mix of complaints and genuine delight. For many, even the blandest menu felt like luxury compared to the scraps they’d been living on.
Kai smirked faintly as he listened.
’They’re celebrating like it’s a feast... and maybe it is, after ten days of hell.’
More voices came as they continued checking their rewards
"I got a 30% discount voucher for the Gene Trader!"
"Lucky! Mine’s only 20%... but I also got a Survival Gift Pack!"
"Ha! I got an Entertainment Gift Pack. There’s a deck of cards and even a music player inside! What the heck? Why not Weapon Gift Pack?"
The shelter was buzzing with excitement, and everyone was comparing their rewards like children opening presents.
Then Victor’s voice came, louder than the rest. The mechanic sounded almost like he was squealing.
"Yes! A Mechanic Treasure Chest! I knew it! I knew the system was tracking my work!"
Kai could practically picture him bouncing in his workshop, already imagining the tools and schematics inside.
The mood was infectious.
Even though the Global Event Cycle Update had warned them about the next event in twelve days, nobody seemed to care.
For now, they were happy, laughing, eating, and showing off their prizes.
Kai smirked, listening to the noise they’re making.
’Well... They deserve this moment. After everything that had happened, even a simple MRE feels like a true victory.’
In any case, Kai was already satisfied hearing their positive mood as he shut out the noise and turned his attention back to his own interface.
Soon, he retrieved a familiar Token in his inventory... It was the same item he got after reaching Level 20! Now, he has another one for completing the event!
Just like that, he tapped the Superior Gene Skill Awakening Token.
There was a confirmation to activate it, and Kai accepted.
[ Token activation initiated... ]
[ Processing... ]
Just like before, four options appeared before his eyes...
[ Active Gene Skill: Fast Appraisal ]
[ Description: Allows the user to analyze and identify the properties of items, equipment, and materials. Provides sufficient information on rarity, potential upgrades, and hidden functions. ]
[ Active Gene Skill: Phantom Dash ]
[ Description: A burst of speed that ignores terrain obstacles for a very short distance. ]
[ Passive Gene Skill: Hardened Body ]
[ Description: Increases skeletal and muscular resilience, reducing blunt damage taken. ]
[ Passive Gene Skill: Hard Focus ]
[ Description: Enhances concentration during combat, improving accuracy and critical strike chance. ]
To be honest, they were all good skills in Kai’s opinion.
However, one of them was just too good to be true. He could never pass this up since it may not appear again.
Without a doubt, Kai’s eyes lingered on the first skill.
’Fast Appraisal... this is exactly what I need. With all these new items, being able to understand their true value will give me an edge.’
He selected it without hesitation.
[ Gene Skill Acquired: Fast Appraisal ]
[ Token Activation Successful. ]
Kai exhaled, satisfied. ’Perfect. Now I won’t have to guess about the non-system items.’
He couldn’t help but feel excited about this. After all, only those recognized by the system could have an Item Description before.
This time, however, with the help of Appraisal, it wouldn’t matter if it was this world’s item or not! He will be able to recognize whatever it was...
[ Fast Appraisal Lv0: Allows the user to analyze and identify the properties of items, equipment, and materials. Provides sufficient information on rarity, potential upgrades, and functions.
Spirit Point Cost: 15
Cooldown: 30 seconds
Range: Direct contact only ]
He frowned slightly.
’Direct contact only... no ranged appraisal? That’s disappointing. I was hoping I could scan items from a distance, or even check equipment without touching it.’
Still, he exhaled and nodded.

’It’s fine. Even with this limitation, it’s going to be useful in so many ways. At least now I won’t have to guess about items that don’t have system descriptions. This skill will save me from wasting resources or overlooking hidden functions.’
Satisfied, Kai turned his attention to the three Special Material Treasure Chests sitting in his inventory.
Their icons glowed faintly, more ornate than the Rare Material Chests he had opened before.
He hesitated for a moment, considering whether he should open this in his room...
After all, once opened, they could no longer be stored in this inventory unless he used his limited Inventory Slots.
’Special grade... higher than rare. These should contain advanced crafting resources. I’ll open one first and see what kind of materials the system provides.’
He then tapped the chest.
[ Do you want to open the Special Material Treasure Chest? ]
Kai confirmed.
[ Special Material Treasure Chest Opened ]
[ You have obtained the following materials:
Titanium Alloy Ingots ×5
Carbon Fiber Sheets ×10
Nano‐Circuit Boards ×10
Synthetic Leather Rolls ×10
Thermal‐Regulating Fabric ×10
Energy Cores (C-Grade) ×10 ]
Kai’s eyes widened slightly as he scrolled through the list.
’Titanium alloy... carbon fiber... nano‐circuits...’
These are far beyond the usual iron and copper ingots he got before... With these, Victor could probably build advanced traps or even upgrade their shelter defenses later on.
However, Kai only had a vague idea about the Nano-Circuit Board, so Kai decided to appraise it to make sure what it really was...
[ Fast Appraisal Activated ]
[ Spirit Point Cost: 15 ]
[ Cooldown: 30 seconds ]
[ You have discovered Nano Circuit Board! ]
[ Grade: Special Material ]
[ Description: A small circuit board used to control energy flow in machines. Needed for building advanced traps, weapons, or shelter devices...

chapters.title: Chapter 132: The Evil Thoughts
paragraphs: "Wait... What?" Kai was stunned as he saw the Appraisal Result!
This was a huge deal!
[ You have discovered Nano Circuit Board! ]
[ Grade: Special Material ]
[ Description: A small circuit board designed to control energy flow in machines. Commonly used in advanced traps, weapons, or shelter devices. ]
[ Note: This board can replace damaged or drained Sentinel circuits. It is one of the required components to change their programming. ]
"It’s real..." Kai muttered, referring to the Appraisal’s ability to provide not just the name of the item but also the rarity and its function!
Indeed, showing the board’s function was definitely important. The appraisal didn’t describe what the board was made of or the components to build one. It just mentioned how it could be used!
The fact that it could be used to reprogram a Sentinel was a crucial matter. After all, they had a lot of drained Sentinels here!
For now, however, it was just one of the many requirements.
He then checked the other materials, but as he appraised them all and lost a bunch of Spirit Points, he didn’t find them as interesting as the Circuit Board.
Still, he was super happy with the Energy Cores! They were even C-Grades at that!
Just like that, Kai finally turned his attention to his next reward.
It was the ribbon icon within his inventory. It turns out that it was the Exclusive Title Upgrade Chance!
[ Exclusive Title Upgrade Chance Available ]
[ Do you want to activate? ]
Kai confirmed.
[ Title Upgrade Process Initiated... ]
[ Processing... ]
Soon, four of his current titles appeared before him:
[ Title: Skilled Survivor ]
[ Title: Pioneer ]
[ Title: Siege Breaker ]
[ Title: Guardian ]
Kai studied them carefully. Each one represented a milestone in his journey so far.
The Skilled Survivor Title was basically something that would help him endure and adapt. He got it after his Survivor Title got upgraded when he reached Level 20.

As for the Pioneer Title, it was something he received after breaking through Level 5 when he absorbed the C-Grade Sentinel’s energy core. In any case, this title could give him a faster Gene Skill Proficiency Increase Rate.
Siege Breaker Title, on the other hand, was something he obtained after the first Global Event, Mech Siege... It gave him increased Health and Spirit Recovery.
Lastly, the new Guardian Title that he received after reaching Level 20...
’Is it this one then?’Kai mused...
It was basically a title that boosted his physical defense, heightened his pain tolerance, and fixed his low stamina!
’What to do here?’
He was in a dilemma...
It was a pity that he could not see what kind of upgrade would happen.
If there was a hint, he’d be able to select the best possible option...
"The Skilled Survivor will probably evolve on its own if I level up... Then, the Siege Breaker’s upgrade will happen after the next Mech Siege Event..."
Kai was torn apart...
In the end, he made his choice...
"Aarrghh... This should do! I got you from level 5... You need to be better!"
With that set, he selected Pioneer, and just like that, it was upgraded!
[ You have selected Pioneer Title. ]
[ Title Upgrade has started... ]
[ Congratulations, your title has been upgraded to Trailblazer! ]

[ Trailblazer: A title that pushes the user’s growth beyond normal limits. It increases proficiency gain for all Gene Skills by 30% and boosts the chance of unlocking new Gene Skill branches when leveling. ]
"Thirty percent increase? I’ll take it..." Kai muttered. He really liked this since his reliance on Skill Points would drop a lot thanks to this title.
After all, Skill Points were just too precious!
As a matter of fact, in this 10-day event, he only got two Skill Points as a reward, even after being the top performer!
He expected that the others would get one or even none at all!
"This is awesome..." Kai muttered as his attention turned to his collection of Survivor Medals...
He got 7 Medals from the Event Rewards, while another 6 Medals from the Hidden Quest Rewards... Furthermore, he earned some more from the others after conducting a trade...
Now, he had a total of 21 Survivor Medals!

’Right. Some of them haven’t paid yet. They should have medals by now... They’ll probably pay me later. If not, I’ll just remind them...’ Kai mused as he was already thinking of what item he’d get from the Gene Trader.
In the meantime, Terrence, the man with Epic Pathfinder Talent and part of Claire’s Assault Team B, couldn’t help but pause at the reward he had just received...
His Gene Skill Awakening Token had just given him a powerful reward!
’Isn’t this too good to be true?’
The Pathfinder Talent was already powerful since it always kept him safe... He could also guide others through danger.
But now, the system had given him something far more insidious!
[ New Gene Skill Awakened! ]
[ Skill: Hypnotic Suggestion Lv0 ]

[ Description: Allows the user to place a target into a trance, manipulate their minds, suppressing memory and awareness for up to 10 minutes. Duration may extend depending on the target’s mental resilience. Target will forget all actions during the effect. ]
A slow grin spread across his face.
’Ten minutes... enough to bend someone’s will. Enough to make them forget what they’ve done. Enough to make them mine. Why is this too perfect?’
His mind was already considering a lot of possibilities.
He knew that the perfect way to use this was against his rivals... He could make someone hand over their rewards. He could plant ideas, stir chaos, and no one would even remember...

And in the shelter, there were plenty of targets. Survivors who trusted too easily. Leaders who thought they were untouchable. Even Claire’s Assault Team B, the very group he was part of... he could turn them against each other without lifting a blade if he ever wanted...
But then, Terrence’s thoughts darkened further.
His thoughts turned toward a few beautiful figures within the shelter. There were Sera, Althea, Elena... and Marissa, barely twenty‐one, and she was full of youthful energy...
Terrence licked his lips as he almost couldn’t contain his excitement.
’No... Not yet. It can be too risky. I have to be calm and test its limit first. I can’t be hasty... No one must know about this...’

chapters.title: Chapter 133: Shelter’s Operation and the Outside
paragraphs: The next day began with Kai’s voice echoing through the mess hall.
Everyone within the shelter had gathered here under his command.
Some are still sleepy because they were on night shift, while others are just groggy from waking early.
Regardless of their condition, they had all come because Kai had informed them that their current path needed to be discussed right now.

"From today onward, all Foreign Survivors must provide one Survivor Medal each month. That will cover your two meals a day. As for the locals, since you don’t have access to Survivor Medals, you’ll continue to serve through your duties..."
Soon, Kai explained the coverage of the Medals and how the others would continue on their daily tasks...
The announcement rippled through the crowd.
They all agreed to this demand since there was a need for order. Since Kai could give them that, they didn’t mind following him...
Soon, Kai reminded them of the Status Crystal, the tool that revealed the locals’ stats and skills since they couldn’t access the System directly.
From the information they had gathered, the locals had been divided into two groups... the Support and Fighter Groups...

The Support Group, where nurse Irene, chef Mila, Rudy, and others belonged, was tasked with cooking, cleaning, laundry, and keeping the shelter running smoothly. Ten hours of labor a day was their payment for food and resources.

On the other hand, the Fighter Group, where Russel, Augustine, Gabby, Dylan, and several others were expected to join combat operations against the mechanized soldiers of the A.I. Army... They should all be working alongside the three combat teams...
Wallace’s Wall Defenders, Claire’s Assault Team B, and Ralph’s Assault Team A.
"Of course... The more Survivor Medals you contribute, or the more useful resources you scavenge outside, the more rewards I’ll provide."
This hinted at the fact that they could get more bullets from him.
Everyone knew Kai was the only one capable of producing bullets in large quantities. Foreign Survivors had recently received crates of ammo, but most of it was mismatched.
There were shotgun shells and many high‐caliber rounds that didn’t fit their weapons.
Kai’s bullets, on the other hand, were perfect for their revolvers...
After everyone agreed to Kai’s arrangement, breakfast began soon after.
Rudy, sweating from the heat of the kitchen, ladled steaming noodle soup with meatloaf and moringa leaves into bowls.
Survivors lined up, one by one, until only Terrence remained at the end of the line.
Terrence’s eyes lit up... He had an idea!
Since he hadn’t tried using his new Skill yet, he might as well do some tests right now.
’Perfect. He’s tired, distracted, and no one pays attention to the last man in line.’
He then activated his new skill and targeted Rudy!
Just like that, his Hypnotic Suggestion hit Rudy, costing him 20 Spirit Points...
Rudy’s eyes dulled, and soon, his movements slowed.
"Give me another serving," Terrence whispered.
Without hesitation, Rudy handed him a second bowl.
Terrence smirked, savoring the victory as much as the soup.
’So it works. He shouldn’t remember this, just like what the system said, but let’s see...’
The only problem now was the fact that he couldn’t cancel the Skill early!
The 10 minutes must be completely used up!
"Ahem... Rudy, just work like you do every day. Act normal." Terrence immediately said, and as expected, Rudy just continued on his work in the kitchen.
It was just a simple test, but it should be enough to prove the skill’s power.
Soon, he returned to his seat and silently ate his meal...
’If I can make Rudy forget, I can make anyone forget. This should work... I’ll be able to control this shelter from behind the scenes...’
As he thought of this, he finally decided to use all of his remaining Skill Points to enhance his Gene Skill!
[ Skill: Hypnotic Suggestion Lv5 ]

[ Description: Allows the user to place a target into a trance, manipulate their minds, suppressing memory and awareness for up to 24 minutes. Duration may extend depending on the target’s mental resilience. Target will forget all actions during the effect. ]
"Now... This looks more exciting..." Terrence muttered after seeing the effects.
Soon, he noticed that Rudy came to his mind, and after a few moments of hesitation, he just returned to his work as if nothing had happened. He probably felt like he had just dozed off while working.
’That’s perfect...’
Soon, his gaze drifted across the hall.
Claire’s Assault Team B sat together, laughing and eating. Wallace’s Wall Defenders were already discussing patrol schedules. Ralph’s Assault Team A cleaned their guns even as they ate.
Terrence’s grin widened...
He really wanted to sow distrust immediately, so he could swiftly take control of a huge part of the shelter.
However, he considered enjoying himself for now...
His eyes turned toward Sera, Althea, Elena, and Marissa.
Terrence licked his lips, suppressing a laugh.
’Just one target at a time. The skill only works on one person, so I’ll need to be patient. I’ll have to learn their schedules, wait for the right moment, and strike when they’re alone...’
He knew that each of them had their routines.

He vaguely heard that Sera would sometimes help Irene with medical duties, Althea often joins Wallace’s patrols even if she didn’t have to, while Elena spends time with Ralph’s shooters, and Marissa... he wasn’t sure about her yet.
Terrence’s fingers tapped against the table as he considered what to do...
However, before he could dwell further, Claire looked for the new recruit, Alfie, before calling for the rest of her team.
"Assault Team B, gather up. We’re moving out."
Terrence straightened as he controlled his expression.
Soon, he joined the other eight members of the team as they prepared to leave.
Claire then informed everyone about today’s mission to search for a Gene Trader nearby. According to the system, they were still out there, waiting to exchange rare items for Survivor Medals.
"I got eight Survivor Medals. I want to buy the Alpha Gene Serum... What about you, Terrence?" Claire asked as they left the shelter.
They were already far away from the shelter at this point.
"I have ten... Hehe... I completed more hidden missions than you, I guess." Terrence replied with a laugh.
Then, he couldn’t help but observe Claire carefully...
’She’s not that bad... Should I test the skill on Claire tonight?’
But before he could settle on a plan, something unexpected happened.
They heard a buzzing sound coming from the sky!

sentences.text: The next day began with Kai’s voice echoing through the mess hall.
Everyone within the shelter had gathered here under his command.
Some are still sleepy because they were on night shift, while others are just groggy from waking early.
Regardless of their condition, they had all come because Kai had informed them that their current path needed to be discussed right now.
"From today onward, all Foreign Survivors must provide one Survivor Medal each month.
That will cover your two meals a day.
As for the locals, since you don’t have access to Survivor Medals, you’ll continue to serve through your duties..."
Soon, Kai explained the coverage of the Medals and how the others would continue on their daily tasks...
The announcement rippled through the crowd.
They all agreed to this demand since there was a need for order.
Since Kai could give them that, they didn’t mind following him...
Soon, Kai reminded them of the Status Crystal, the tool that revealed the locals’ stats and skills since they couldn’t access the System directly.
From the information they had gathered, the locals had been divided into two groups... the Support and Fighter Groups...
The Support Group, where nurse Irene, chef Mila, Rudy, and others belonged, was tasked with cooking, cleaning, laundry, and keeping the shelter running smoothly.
Ten hours of labor a day was their payment for food and resources.
On the other hand, the Fighter Group, where Russel, Augustine, Gabby, Dylan, and several others were expected to join combat operations against the mechanized soldiers of the A.I.
Army...
They should all be working alongside the three combat teams...
Wallace’s Wall Defenders, Claire’s Assault Team B, and Ralph’s Assault Team A.
"Of course...
The more Survivor Medals you contribute, or the more useful resources you scavenge outside, the more rewards I’ll provide."
This hinted at the fact that they could get more bullets from him.
Everyone knew Kai was the only one capable of producing bullets in large quantities.
Foreign Survivors had recently received crates of ammo, but most of it was mismatched.
There were shotgun shells and many high‐caliber rounds that didn’t fit their weapons.
Kai’s bullets, on the other hand, were perfect for their revolvers...

Rudy, sweating from the heat of the kitchen, ladled steaming noodle soup with meatloaf and moringa leaves into bowls.

Terrence’s eyes lit up...
He had an idea!
Since he hadn’t tried using his new Skill yet, he might as well do some tests right now.

Just like that, his Hypnotic Suggestion hit Rudy, costing him 20 Spirit Points...

He shouldn’t remember this, just like what the system said, but let’s see...’

The 10 minutes must be completely used up!

Act normal." Terrence immediately said, and as expected, Rudy just continued on his work in the kitchen.

chapters.title: Chapter 134: New Unit and the Gene Trader
paragraphs: "Swarmers! Hide!" Claire immediately ordered as soon as she heard the noise above them.
Even without seeing them, she recognized the buzzing sound already...
As a matter of fact, Russel and some others were already moving before Claire gave the command.
As for the rest, they had to quickly hide!
Thankfully, all of them are wearing camouflage suits, and they were also in the forest! They should have some advantage.
Furthermore, they had faced Swarmers before... They were tiny insect‐like drones that attacked in clusters. They were weak alone, but terrifying in numbers.
If there weren’t a lot of these drones, they should be able to eliminate all of them at once.
"Sshhh... Do not move. They’re getting close." Russel reminded.
Once they found humans, they would swarm with their needle‐like appendages... Of course, they weren’t draining blood, but instead, they’d normally inject toxins that would paralyze humans.

They needed to be careful when facing them. After all, if these Swarmers weren’t successful in their hunt or there were too many humans for them to handle, they would actually retreat and call for Sentinels.
Whoosshh~
The team quickly ducked under the canopy of trees, pressing themselves against roots and foliage.
As the buzzing grew louder, they all felt a little nervous...
But as they waited, Terrence frowned. Something was off.
The sound was similar, but the shadows passing overhead were larger!
"This is..."
Claire’s eyes widened as she risked a glance upward.
Then, she froze...
These were not Swarmers.

Above them, three small flying vehicles passed overhead... They noticed two mechanized soldiers that looked like Sentinels were mounted on these compact crafts as they hovered and dashed through the air.
’Flying jetskis?’Claire thought as she looked above...
The machines had solid frames with small indicator lights along their sides.
Surprisingly, these machines weren’t making a very loud noise at all. They were comparable to the sound created by the Swarmers.
Still, Claire’s heart sank.
’New units... Did the system make an update without telling us?’She couldn’t help but complain inwardly.

However, she already knew that the A.I. Civilization had many types of mechanized units. Perhaps, since they had just finished the first phase of the Apocalypse, they weren’t targeted by stronger A.I. Soldiers yet.
But with the end of the Tyrant Hunt, it seemed that they would be facing stronger enemies from now on.

Up to this point, they had only encountered Swarmers, Sentinels, Hounds, Spyders, and Tyrants... each dangerous in its own way. The Ascendant Unit, however, wasn’t something they had fought against, so Claire couldn’t do it in...
Nonetheless, these flying units, or maybe Sentinel Sky Riders, were something different.
’Ahh... That’s weird...’ Claire thought as he realized that the sentinel in front driving the flying unit, was fused directly to its machine.
Indeed!
Its lower body was merged into the jetski, or flying vehicle’s frame, while its arms drove it!
Behind it sat a Sentinel soldier, gripping a plasma rifle, scanning the forest below.
Whoosh~ Whoosh~ Whoosh~
The three jetskis circled the area as they searched for signs of life.
At this point, even Terrence felt a little scared... If they were found, they had to ensure that the three would be destroyed, or more of them would come and search for their traces.
The team held their breath...
Thankfully, even as leaves rustled faintly, the machines didn’t descend.
After several tense minutes, the buzzing sound of the vehicle’s engine faded as the units moved on!
Claire exhaled slowly, as she finally relaxed...
"They didn’t see us... but we’re not moving yet. They might circle back." She reminded.
After all, it would be a disaster if those things didn’t completely leave yet..
For twenty long minutes, the team remained hidden.
Finally, when the forest grew quiet again, Claire gathered them.
"What the heck are those?"
"It’s my first time seeing them."
"Even the previous elder didn’t mention those flying units..."
"It might be new ones. But it might just be their first time going around this area."
"That’s true... The flying vehicle didn’t look new. Some parts had rust all over."
"I guess they’re just from a different region or something."
The others couldn’t help but guess.
Of course, Claire had similar thoughts, so she shared what was on her mind.
"Yes. We’ve survived the Mech Siege and the Tyrant Hunt... So, it looks like the system has updated the A.I. Army. These flying units might be the new Sentinels. We’ll need to report this to Kai."
Russel cursed under his breath. "As if normal Sentinels weren’t bad enough."
Gabby nodded as she tightened her grip on her weapon, as she knew how dangerous those flying units could be.
"If they can scout from the air, nowhere is safe."
Soon, the team pressed onward, and of course, they were cautious now.
Their mission was still the same... to find a Gene Trader.
Although they were already aware of the location of one of them, it was actually a bit too far, and because of that, it would be very dangerous to travel to and from...
They could be exposed to so many enemies...
Furthermore, they were also planning to abuse the trap, and if it was too far, it would be difficult to mobilize their forces.
Because of that, they limited their search to around three miles of their shelter...
They moved through abandoned sites where the Gene Trader could be hiding. Soon, they arrived at an abandoned town.
"There must be one around here..." Claire firmly believed that one of the Gene Traders was definitely here!
Soon, their group searched a collapsed supermarket.
There were broken carts, collapsed stalls, and dust that coated everything...
Furthermore, there was a stench of rot lingering around.
Claire ordered a quick sweep, but nothing useful remained.
Next was a half‐destroyed apartment block.
The walls were cracked with vines crawling through broken windows. Augustine found a stash of old clothes, but nothing of value.
Soon, Dylan also checked the basement, only to find it flooded.
Hours passed as they searched, but they weren’t finding anything. Not the Gene Trader or any valuable resources they could bring back.
Finally, as they felt that they were wasting time and Claire was about to give a retreat order, one of them spotted something unusual.
He found a wooden structure perched in a large tree at the center of the town!
"A treehouse?" Claire muttered as she saw it...
It was very well made, and it was even camouflaged with leaves.
Claire raised her hand. "That’s it. The Gene Trader must be there!"
Just like that, the team approached cautiously.
Needless to say, to avoid activating the trap, they had decided to send Terrence instead!
At this time, Terrence noticed a rope ladder dangling from the treehouse. It was swaying slightly in the breeze.
"Careful, Terrence... There might be something else living there. Snakes... or maybe a bear." Claire warned.
Terrence smirked. "I will... Also, you can just call me Renz..."
"Renz? Alright..." Claire easily agreed.
Then, as Terrence climbed, he could hear the creaking of the ladder...
It might break at any moment. They definitely had to replace this thing later.
At the top, Terrence swiftly entered the treehouse.
Inside, he immediately recognized the scent of herbs and machinery. Then, at the center, he recognized the familiar Gene Trader!
The Trader was tall, wearing a dark cloak, and seemed like it would disappear at any moment.
It was the familiar appearance of the Gene Trader...
"It’s here!" Terrence immediately informed the people below!
Just like that, everyone celebrated.
Claire immediately ordered a few items to make a new robe ladder. After all, she could tell that the current ones are too brittle at this moment.
In any case, they had plenty of robes in their bags, so it was not a big deal for them...
Meanwhile, Terrence immediately approached the Trader.
Similar to before, the cloaked figure gave no greetings or words...
Instead, the Gene Trader raised a hand and placed a crystal in front of him. The crystal floated upward, glowing faintly, before transforming into a notification window!
[ Gene Trader’s Store ]
[ Survivor Medal Items ] [ Energy Core Items ]
Just like that, he selected the Survivor Medal Items.
He had seen this before...
There were four versions of Enhancement Serums... The Super, Alpha, Prime, and Mutagenic.
Except for the Mutagenic, which costs 1 Medal, the rest cost 3 Medals.
’It’s the same items...’Terrence muttered after noticing the pills, weapons, accessories, and gene skill crystals being sold...
However, he noticed that this Gene Trader had an additional implant!
The one he was familiar with was the eye implant...
[ Ocular Replacement Implant: A bioengineered eye designed to permanently replace a missing or damaged one. It restores full vision immediately, grants Appraisal Ability...
Cost: 10 Survivor Medals ]
It was something everyone really wanted because of Appraisal Ability... However, since they have perfectly healthy eyes right now, none of them wanted to modify their bodies just yet.
They were also hopeful to get Appraisal Ability through Gene Skill instead...
However, the additional implant being sold was something unexpected!
It was called Arm Replacement Implant, but designed not only to replace a missing limb but also to function as an additional, third arm... even for those who still had two perfectly healthy hands!
