chapters.title: Chapter 135: Claire’s Response
paragraphs: [ Arm Replacement Implant: A mechanical arm grafted directly to the body. Designed not only to replace a missing limb but also to function as an additional, third arm, even for those who already have two perfectly healthy hands. Grants permanent Strength increase, superior grip, and the ability to wield or carry multiple weapons simultaneously. The process guarantees severe muscle strain and nerve pain during adaptation, unless the user’s physique is strong enough to stabilize quickly.
Cost: 14 Survivor Medals ]
Terrence’s eyes widened as he read the description.
’The heck? A third arm... even if I don’t lose one? That’s insane...’
He focused for a moment on the floating window. To be honest, he was quite interested in this item...
"This... this is perfect."
At this point, a few others had already reached his side.
Specifically, Claire and Alfie couldn’t help but feel surprised after seeing the window screen that the Gene Trader was showing to Terrence.
Aflie muttered, "That’s too much... Adding another arm will guarantee that you will not be getting ready."

Even Claire shook her head... "That’s true. You can’t really purchase this one if you have a missing arm. You’ll get the Limb Reconstruction Capsule instead for a lower price. That’s only 10 Survivor Medals.
"Alfie, I think you’d be able to handle girls better if you had another arm..." Terrence jabbed.
However, Claire glared at him, so he raised his hands.
"Just kidding... But I have a 50% Discount Voucher with me. So I’m thinking of getting one of these."
Of course, even with his lecherous thoughts, he also considered other benefits of this item.
’I could fight with one more weapon at once... No one would expect it if I hide my third arm well. I should put it on my back and cover it with a cloak or mantle... No one could stop me.’
"You’re really going to buy one?" Claire asked in surprise. She didn’t expect that Terrence would be this decisive.
Seeing Terrence nod, she realized that they indeed have different values.
While she liked to always stay beautiful and be accepted by the standards of most people, Terrence actually didn’t care as long as he got an edge or advantage over others.
It was definitely something impressive!
In this Apocalypse, having such a mindset would help him in the long run.
For a moment, Claire couldn’t help but envy his carefree attitude.
Meanwhile, after seeing Claire and Alfie’s reaction, Terrence almost laughed out loud. He knew what they were thinking at this point.

’This is too good to be true... They can’t understand how this world differs from Earth. This is a must-have... The medals I’ll spend here are nothing compared to the power this gives me...’Terrence thought.
Since the others are too afraid of looking like monsters, he’ll be different and embrace it.
’I’ll become stronger than all of them. No matter what the cost.’
He clenched his fists, already imagining the mechanical arm sprouting from his back...
To be honest, he wasn’t so desperate to obtain power over people before. He had even saved Jonas and Aurora when Haven-15 was destroyed during the Mech Siege.
Back on Earth, Terrence had lived with the mindset of a Security Guard, a man who believed his duty was to uphold justice, protect others, and remain fair no matter the situation.

That sense of responsibility had basically defined him, and it shaped his choices and his identity. But the destruction of Haven‐15 during the Mech Siege, combined with the various changes brought by the System, like updates, events, and the introduction of the Leaderboard, forced him to confront a harsh truth...
In this new world, fairness meant nothing, and being passive could cost him his life.
Terrence finally understood that if he continued to cling to his old ideals, he would be left behind. He would be powerless in a world that rewarded only the strong...
He needed to grow stronger, not just to survive in the Apocalypse, but to seize the achievements or rewards given by the System from missions and events.
’I’ll be the one to end this Apocalypse...’Terrence thought as he couldn’t help but imagine how he would start as the leader of the New Shelter-45...
He knew that this would be possible with his Hypnotic Suggestion Skill. Furthermore, with his unique Pathfinder Talent, he believed he was naturally suited to rise as a leader.
In Terrence’s mind, Kai was useful, but only as a subordinate.
At best, he could serve as a vice leader... someone capable of handling logistics and keeping people organized, but not someone truly fit to stand at the top.
Kai didn’t strike Terrence as strong. His influence came almost entirely from Atom’s presence and from the mysterious supply lines he controlled.

Without those advantages, Kai was ordinary, nothing special. Terrence believed this would become even more obvious once their group found ways to be more self‐sufficient, especially with food and basic resources.
’Right... Kai’s ability only matters in the first phase of the Apocalypse,’Terrence thought.
’Once we grow stronger and establish reliable ways to procure supplies, he’ll be useless.’
Terrence contrasted that with himself.
He saw himself as fundamentally different. He had an incredible talent, Pathfinder, which gave him unique opportunities to explore, discover, and lead.
He had the drive to push forward, to end the Apocalypse rather than simply endure it.
And unlike Kai, Terrence was willing to embrace invasive implants, to sacrifice comfort and appearance, no matter the cost, if it meant gaining an edge.
To him, that willingness was proof of his superiority.
Soon, Terrence confirmed the purchase with a faint grin.
After the purchase, it went directly into his Inventory... Just like that, the voucher and the 7 Survivor Medals were gone...
Still, he didn’t intend to use it immediately... After all, the complete description finally appeared, and it wouldn’t be easy.
The thought of grafting a third arm onto his body was thrilling, but he learned that this would not be a painless move. It would be a painful process!
For now, it was enough to know he had it, waiting for the right moment.
Soon after, Alfie stepped forward to make his own transaction. He had eight Survivor Medals to spend, and unlike Claire, he wasn’t holding back. His choices were straightforward...
He used four medals for a Super Gene Enhancement Serum, three medals for a low‐grade Gene Skill Crystal, and one medal for a Rapid Recovery Pill.
The Gene Trader’s crystal pulsed faintly as each item was transferred, and Alfie’s expression brightened.
He had invested everything, and though his selections weren’t flashy, they were practical. Alfie was the type who valued immediate utility over long‐term risk.
Claire, however, approached with a different mindset.
She also had eight medals, but she wasn’t willing to spend them all here.
She planned to reserve four for a future trade with Kai, calculating that such a move would strengthen her position within the shelter.
That left her with only four medals to spend now.
Without hesitation, she purchased a Prime Gene Enhancement Serum.

The choice was deliberate. Unlike the Super Gene version Alfie had chosen, the Prime Gene focused heavily on vitality improvement. For Claire, this was essential. Her Talent, Fifth Sin, was powerful but dangerous.
She recalled the spirit’s caution vividly.
Each time it took control of her body, the cost was not just fatigue or temporary damage, but a permanent loss of her own life force.
It wasn’t something she could ever recover, and the thought lingered like a shadow whenever she considered relying on its power.
The Prime Serum was her safeguard, a way to reinforce her vitality against the toll her Talent or perhaps, Spirit, demanded.
Nonetheless, when Alfie finished, he turned away from the glowing crystal.
"I’ll go now... I’m not interested in items being sold for Experience Points." He waved dismissively at the shelves of worldly goods...
He saw laptops, flashlights, spices, cameras, thermoses, wristwatches, and even packs of cigarettes. To him, they were distractions. He left the treehouse without looking back.
Claire, meanwhile, stayed to check them all... She was scanning them all with curiosity.
Terrence stayed as well, watching her closely while the Gene Trader stood silently in the corner...
’Hmm... Interesting... This might be a perfect chance.’
Terrence thought as he licked his lips...
What mattered now was that Alfie was gone. It was just him and Claire.
He stepped closer behind her and spoke...
"Claire... Have a meal with me after this. I want to get to know you more."
As he spoke, he activated his Hypnotic Suggestion Skill, expecting her to immediately agree...
But Claire frowned, her gaze fixed on the items before her...
"I don’t want to." She answered with a dismissive tone... She didn’t even glance at him.
Terrence froze...
’What? That should have worked...’
He couldn’t understand why the skill failed! He had even used all his Skill Points to push it to Level 5!
’Wait. Is it because there’s no eye contact, and the effect became weak?’

Designed not only to replace a missing limb but also to function as an additional, third arm, even for those who already have two perfectly healthy hands.
Grants permanent Strength increase, superior grip, and the ability to wield or carry multiple weapons simultaneously.
The process guarantees severe muscle strain and nerve pain during adaptation, unless the user’s physique is strong enough to stabilize quickly.
Cost: 14 Survivor Medals ]

A third arm... even if I don’t lose one?
That’s insane...’
He focused for a moment on the floating window.
To be honest, he was quite interested in this item...
"This... this is perfect."

Aflie muttered, "That’s too much...
Adding another arm will guarantee that you will not be getting ready."
Even Claire shook her head...

You can’t really purchase this one if you have a missing arm.
You’ll get the Limb Reconstruction Capsule instead for a lower price.
That’s only 10 Survivor Medals.

"Just kidding...
But I have a 50% Discount Voucher with me.
So I’m thinking of getting one of these."

’I could fight with one more weapon at once...
No one would expect it if I hide my third arm well.
I should put it on my back and cover it with a cloak or mantle...
No one could stop me.’

It was definitely something impressive!

Furthermore, with his unique Pathfinder Talent, he believed he was naturally suited to rise as a leader.
In Terrence’s mind, Kai was useful, but only as a subordinate.
At best, he could serve as a vice leader... someone capable of handling logistics and keeping people organized, but not someone truly fit to stand at the top.
Kai didn’t strike Terrence as strong.
His influence came almost entirely from Atom’s presence and from the mysterious supply lines he controlled.

chapters.title: Chapter 136: Accumulation
paragraphs: Terrence was confused.
He was sure it would work even without any eye-to-eye or direct contact at all.
Still, because Claire was also a high-level Survivor, the condition might be a lot harder than he thought...
’Shit... I can’t fail now...’
Determined, he moved in front of her, placing his hands firmly on her shoulders.
Then, he leaned closer, locking his eyes onto hers, and pushed the skill again.
"Claire... I think you misheard me. I’m telling you to have a meal with me. Just eat with me and follow me." He ordered once again using his skill.
But instead of compliance, Claire just frowned even more!
Her annoyance was unmistakable at this point.
"Stop it, Terrence. I don’t appreciate this."
The words hit him harder than he expected.
His Hypnotic Suggestion had failed twice! He spent a lot of Skill Points for nothing!
He had never imagined Claire would resist so strongly. For a moment, his confidence wavered.
’Why isn’t it working? Is it her Talent?’
He clenched his jaw as he had no idea how to save this situation.
Claire wasn’t just rejecting him... she was defying the very skill he believed gave him control. The realization distressed him.
It appears that his advantage wasn’t absolute. There were limits, and Claire had just exposed them.
Claire, meanwhile, ignored his confusion and slapped his hands away!
If Terrence failed to respect her space once again, he’d definitely get hit harder than that. This would be his last chance!
So after taking a deep breath, she returned her focus to the Gene Trader, calmly reviewing the remaining items.
’You should learn how to accept rejection...’Claire mused.
To her, Terrence’s attempt was nothing more than an annoyance, a distraction from what truly mattered.
She had no interest in his games...
Terrence stepped back while masking his frustration with a forced smile.
Inside, though, he was agitated...
’So that’s how it is... She can really resist me.’
At this point, he knew that he had to step back and rethink his plans!
He had to stop provoking her, or he’d really get punched!
Soon, Claire tilted her head slightly as she noticed Terrence finally leaving the treehouse.
His forced smile lingered in her mind, but she dismissed it quickly.
She had no idea what had just happened to her, only that his behavior was strange. She’d definitely report this to Kai later.
Then she heard it.
’Hihihi...’
There was a faint giggle, echoing in her mind.
She stiffened.

The sound wasn’t coming from the Gene Trader, nor from outside. It was her spirit companion. Invisible to everyone else, but it hovered near her, amused. She could only see its vague figure, but it was definitely the spirit...
Claire frowned. "Why are you laughing like that?" she whispered under her breath, careful not to draw attention.
She didn’t want others to see that she was talking to nothing.
The spirit turned around lazily in the air...
It didn’t answer, only laughed harder, as if watching a comedy unfold.
Claire’s patience thinned.
"Tell me. What happened just now? Why are you laughing at me?"
The spirit tilted its head, feigning innocence."Oh, nothing... just watching you deal with Terrence. He’s... entertaining."
Claire narrowed her eyes. "Stop playing around. You never laugh like this unless something happened. Speak."
The spirit floated closer, circling her like a mischievous shadow.
"You really don’t know? He tried to use a Gene Skill on you. Hypnotism. Twice."
Claire’s eyes widened. "What? So that’s why you’re laughing so much..."
"Yes. He thought he could bend your will so easily... But your Talent now is too strong. His skill couldn’t touch you."
Claire’s heart raced.
She had felt annoyed, irritated by Terrence’s insistence, but she hadn’t realized he was actively trying to manipulate her.
"So that’s why he kept pressing me... He was using a skill?" This was a serious matter that must be addressed...

The spirit nodded, still chuckling."Exactly. He wasted his points, and you resisted without even knowing. That’s why I laughed. He thought he had a chance! But your Talent makes you far stronger than he realizes."
Claire exhaled slowly. Her previous annoyance had now shifted into realization.
Her Talent wasn’t just about accumulating wealth... it was a shield, a foundation that made her harder to influence for sure!
She remembered the deal she had made before leaving the shelter.
At first, she had only asked Kai for bullets and basic supplies.
But Kai had insisted she needed more, that she should grow stronger quickly.
In the end, he had given her thirty drained Sentinels!
"Did I become that strong already? I think I should really test my strength right now..." She muttered.
After all, although those humanoid machines may not have any energy and be unable to function, they still count as valuable resources!
That gift had changed everything.
Thirty Sentinels meant immense wealth in the eyes of the System.
And with her Talent, that wealth translated directly into strength. This strength wasn’t just physical, but it also boosted her spirit!
Then, her Talent’s Spirit, whom she suspected as Greed, spoke with an amused tone...

"Yeah~ That’s why his hypnotism failed. Your wealth has grown beyond what he can overcome. Every bullet, every tool, every drained Sentinel Kai gave you... It all feeds your Talent. You lucky sucker... I told you already! You have to start sleeping with Kai and get more! If you’re slow, Sera and Althea will take him!"
Claire shook her head after hearing this...
"I already have a family back on Earth... Besides, I’m already too old for Kai. Stop suggesting that or I’ll get angry..." She replied seriously.
This made Greed stop for a moment.

Still, Claire hadn’t realized the full extent of her protection until now. Terrence’s failure wasn’t just his weakness... it was her strength. For the first time, she felt that she could actually become a main character with her current abilities!
After taking a deep breath, she turned and asked. "Is that a laughing matter?"

The spirit nodded without hesitation."Because he thought he could control you. He believed his skill was absolute. But you, Claire... you’re untouchable from that kind of ability... He doesn’t even know why. To me, it’s hilarious."
Claire shook her head, half‐amused, half‐troubled.
She glanced at the Gene Trader’s glowing crystal, pretending to browse while her thoughts processed all the information...
Without a doubt, Terrence would likely try again... and next time, his Targets may not be someone capable of defending themselves from such attacks.
Now, she was considering whether to subdue Terrence immediately or wait for Kai’s decision...
’No... There’s no need to bother Kai about this. I can handle this!’

chapters.title: Chapter 137: Claire’s Move
paragraphs: Claire took a deep breath as she replayed the spirit’s words in her mind.
Terrence had tried to control her. Twice!

If he was willing to use hypnotism on her in this place, in front of the Gene Trader, then what would stop him from using it back at the shelter? Those with no capability to defend themselves from hypnotism would be in trouble.
Claire clenched her fists as she imagined what kind of problem he’d bring to them...
’If he returns, he’ll twist people to his will. There must be a limit to that ability, but he’ll use his skill for his own benefit. That can’t be allowed.’
Her spirit companion hovered nearby and could tell what she was thinking...
"You see it now, don’t you? He’s dangerous. If you don’t stop him, he’ll spread his influence like poison. Let’s steal everything he has! Let’s increase our wealth, Claire!"
Claire nodded slightly.
For once, she could agree to this Spirit bound to her...
"Yes... but Terrence isn’t easy prey. His Pathfinder Talent makes him slippery. If I don’t subdue him immediately, he’ll vanish, and no one will ever find him again."
She recalled what Terrence had boasted about his Talent...
Apparently, it gives him instinctive awareness of danger, the ability to locate hidden routes, and even the power to cloak himself and others from detection. It was an Epic Talent for sure...
So if she attacked recklessly, he would sense it and escape in the process.
If that really happened, it would be difficult to catch him.
Then, her spirit whispered, amused.
"Then you’ll need my powers... Possession. It’s the only way to overwhelm him before he reacts."
Claire could only nod after hearing this.
She hated relying on possession. Every time the spirit took control, it consumed a portion of her permanent health.
But this was different. This wasn’t about survival alone... it was about protecting the shelter from Terrence’s corruption.
She exhaled slowly, as she considered what to do next...
’I’ll have to plan it carefully. There shouldn’t be any hesitation. If I strike, it must be decisive. Possession first, then subdue him, and drag him to Kai... He’ll decide on what to do with him.’
The spirit chuckled darkly.
"Good. I can tell you’re finally thinking like me. He doesn’t know you’ve seen through him. That ignorance is your weapon."
Claire nodded as she watched the doorway where Terrence had left.
Thanks to her spirit, she knew the truth.
’I have to crush him before Pathfinder can save him.’
In any case, she would wait for the right moment... when Terrence least expected it.
Then she would call upon Greed, let the spirit possess her body, and unleash the full force of her Talent.
"If I don’t stop him now, he’ll become a threat to the entire shelter." Claire whispered...
Needless to say, the Spirit was happy with this development. After all, it also needed wealth and other resources to get stronger!
Terrence seemed to have a decent set of items with him, including the recent item he purchased from the Gene Trader, the Arm Replacement Implant.
If they defeated Terrence, Claire would be the one who’d gain the right to take his items!
Claire smiled as she also realized this...
For now, she remained calm, pretending to browse the Gene Trader’s wares. But inside, her decision was already made. Terrence’s fate was sealed...
Soon, Claire descended from the treehouse...
Once her boots touched the ground, she scanned the area and confirmed that everyone was all gathered close to the treehouse perimeter.
That was good.
It would be harder for Terrence to use his Hypnotic Ability with everyone gathered.
After all, she guessed that Terrence could only use it on one target, considering the fact that he waited for Alfie to leave before using it on her.
Turning to three of her men, she a command...
"Return to the shelter... No, just retreat enough for the radio to reach Kai. Inform him we’ve found the Gene Trader."
The three nodded without hesitation and moved out. Soon, their figures faded into the treeline.
That left six people behind. They were Alfie, Terrence, Claire herself, and three more of her Assault Team B subordinates.
Terrence approached her then, and he seemed almost apologetic. He acted as though nothing had happened, as if his earlier attempt to manipulate her was forgotten.
Claire kept her face neutral, feigning ignorance. She let him believe she hadn’t noticed his hidden intentions.
"Search the surroundings," she ordered the three remaining men. "Check for Sentinels, or those riders on the flying crafts. I don’t want surprises."
The men saluted and dispersed, leaving only Alfie, Terrence, and Claire standing near the treehouse.
Claire turned to Alfie...
Then, she made a subtle hand signal... It was one reserved for emergencies.
It meant she was about to subdue an enemy.
’Huh? Enemy? Where?’
Alfie blinked in confusion. He looked around, baffled at the sign...
There was no enemy in sight. He almost believed that he had misread their hand signals...
However, even after thinking about it, he knew that it was the signal for subduing an enemy!
For a moment, he also thought his Gladiator instincts had dulled, that he had failed to sense danger.
But then Claire’s aura shifted.
Her presence grew stronger, and there was a subtle pressure coming from her.
Alfie heard about this... He heard that Claire had a Talent that could make her really strong.
He wasn’t aware of the details, but it was the reason why Claire was the leader of an Assault Team!
It was the reason why Kai trusted her so much!
Soon, Claire’s eyes turned red, and Alfie felt a little nervous... Still, he finally realized what was going on!
Without hesitation, Claire charged forward.
Her movements were fast!
Furthermore, her body was now empowered by the spirit’s possession. In an instant, she closed the distance and struck at Terrence!
"You crazy wom—"
The attack was sudden and left no room for escape!
Terrence’s eyes widened in shock. He hadn’t expected it... His Pathfinder Talent screamed danger, but it was already too late!

sentences.text: Claire took a deep breath as she replayed the spirit’s words in her mind.
Terrence had tried to control her.
Twice!
If he was willing to use hypnotism on her in this place, in front of the Gene Trader, then what would stop him from using it back at the shelter?
Those with no capability to defend themselves from hypnotism would be in trouble.
Claire clenched her fists as she imagined what kind of problem he’d bring to them...
’If he returns, he’ll twist people to his will.
There must be a limit to that ability, but he’ll use his skill for his own benefit.
That can’t be allowed.’
Her spirit companion hovered nearby and could tell what she was thinking...
"You see it now, don’t you?
He’s dangerous.
If you don’t stop him, he’ll spread his influence like poison.
Let’s steal everything he has!
Let’s increase our wealth, Claire!"
Claire nodded slightly.
For once, she could agree to this Spirit bound to her...
"Yes... but Terrence isn’t easy prey.
His Pathfinder Talent makes him slippery.
If I don’t subdue him immediately, he’ll vanish, and no one will ever find him again."
She recalled what Terrence had boasted about his Talent...
Apparently, it gives him instinctive awareness of danger, the ability to locate hidden routes, and even the power to cloak himself and others from detection.
It was an Epic Talent for sure...
So if she attacked recklessly, he would sense it and escape in the process.
If that really happened, it would be difficult to catch him.
Then, her spirit whispered, amused.
"Then you’ll need my powers...
Possession.
It’s the only way to overwhelm him before he reacts."
Claire could only nod after hearing this.
She hated relying on possession.
Every time the spirit took control, it consumed a portion of her permanent health.
But this was different.
This wasn’t about survival alone... it was about protecting the shelter from Terrence’s corruption.
She exhaled slowly, as she considered what to do next...
’I’ll have to plan it carefully.
There shouldn’t be any hesitation.
If I strike, it must be decisive.
Possession first, then subdue him, and drag him to Kai...
He’ll decide on what to do with him.’
The spirit chuckled darkly.
"Good.
I can tell you’re finally thinking like me.
He doesn’t know you’ve seen through him.
That ignorance is your weapon."
Claire nodded as she watched the doorway where Terrence had left.
Thanks to her spirit, she knew the truth.
’I have to crush him before Pathfinder can save him.’
In any case, she would wait for the right moment... when Terrence least expected it.
Then she would call upon Greed, let the spirit possess her body, and unleash the full force of her Talent.
"If I don’t stop him now, he’ll become a threat to the entire shelter." Claire whispered...
Needless to say, the Spirit was happy with this development.
After all, it also needed wealth and other resources to get stronger!
Terrence seemed to have a decent set of items with him, including the recent item he purchased from the Gene Trader, the Arm Replacement Implant.
If they defeated Terrence, Claire would be the one who’d gain the right to take his items!
Claire smiled as she also realized this...
For now, she remained calm, pretending to browse the Gene Trader’s wares.
But inside, her decision was already made.
Terrence’s fate was sealed...
Soon, Claire descended from the treehouse...
Once her boots touched the ground, she scanned the area and confirmed that everyone was all gathered close to the treehouse perimeter.
That was good.
It would be harder for Terrence to use his Hypnotic Ability with everyone gathered.
After all, she guessed that Terrence could only use it on one target, considering the fact that he waited for Alfie to leave before using it on her.
Turning to three of her men, she a command...
"Return to the shelter...
No, just retreat enough for the radio to reach Kai.
Inform him we’ve found the Gene Trader."
The three nodded without hesitation and moved out.
Soon, their figures faded into the treeline.
That left six people behind.
They were Alfie, Terrence, Claire herself, and three more of her Assault Team B subordinates.
Terrence approached her then, and he seemed almost apologetic.
He acted as though nothing had happened, as if his earlier attempt to manipulate her was forgotten.
Claire kept her face neutral, feigning ignorance.
She let him believe she hadn’t noticed his hidden intentions.
"Search the surroundings," she ordered the three remaining men.
"Check for Sentinels, or those riders on the flying crafts.
I don’t want surprises."
The men saluted and dispersed, leaving only Alfie, Terrence, and Claire standing near the treehouse.
Claire turned to Alfie...
Then, she made a subtle hand signal...
It was one reserved for emergencies.
It meant she was about to subdue an enemy.
’Huh?
Enemy?
Where?’
Alfie blinked in confusion.
He looked around, baffled at the sign...
There was no enemy in sight.
He almost believed that he had misread their hand signals...
However, even after thinking about it, he knew that it was the signal for subduing an enemy!
For a moment, he also thought his Gladiator instincts had dulled, that he had failed to sense danger.
But then Claire’s aura shifted.
Her presence grew stronger, and there was a subtle pressure coming from her.
Alfie heard about this...
He heard that Claire had a Talent that could make her really strong.
He wasn’t aware of the details, but it was the reason why Claire was the leader of an Assault Team!
It was the reason why Kai trusted her so much!
Soon, Claire’s eyes turned red, and Alfie felt a little nervous...
Still, he finally realized what was going on!
Without hesitation, Claire charged forward.
Her movements were fast!
Furthermore, her body was now empowered by the spirit’s possession.
In an instant, she closed the distance and struck at Terrence!
"You crazy wom—"
The attack was sudden and left no room for escape!
Terrence’s eyes widened in shock.
He hadn’t expected it...
His Pathfinder Talent screamed danger, but it was already too late!

chapters.title: Chapter 138: The New Units
paragraphs: Claire had moved faster than his instincts could save him. Everything happened so quickly!
Claire’s body was suddenly filled with unnatural strength the moment she allowed the spirit, Greed, to possess her.
Her Spirit heightened, and her movements became vastly different from her usual moves... It was almost inhuman!
Terrence barely had time to register the change before she closed the distance between them.
"You crazy wom—"
Her hands clamped down on his right arm with terrifying force.
It was Titan Grip, one of her Gene Skills!
It was activated instantly under Greed’s control.
Crack!
Bones cracked audibly, and Terrence screamed in agony.
"Aahck! Wait, stop!" he begged with his voice breaking under the pain. He wasn’t even prepared for this!
But Claire’s possessed strength was merciless.
She twisted his arm further, ensuring the break was complete!
Terrence tried to fight back, but the pain was so unbearable that he wished he’d pass out!
He felt really weak as he clutched his ruined limb. At this moment, his face was pale with shock.
Desperate, he fumbled for his gun with his left hand, trying to raise it toward her.
But Claire moved like a demon. Before he could even aim, she struck his wrist with a swift blow!
Thud!
This move sent the weapon spinning out of his grasp and clattering to the ground!
"Wait! Claire! Let’s talk this out! Sorry for touching you a while ago. I’m really sorry!"
However, Claire was not listening at all!
Terrence’s instincts screamed at him to fight back. He activated his movement Gene Skill, his body surging with speed as he tried to dash away.
For a moment, his figure blurred with his steps being light and evasive.
Furthermore, the Pathfinder’s warning pulsed in his mind. Danger was everywhere and escape was the only option.
But Claire was faster. Possession had turned her into something monstrous. She anticipated his movements, cutting him off at every angle!
’Damn! How is she reading my moves?! She’s not supposed to be this terrifying! What happened to her?!’Terrence was clearly unable to comprehend Claire’s hidden power.
Each time he tried to dash aside, she was already there, striking him down with a smack on his face or his chest.
Terrence swung his fists wildly, trying to counterattack, but Claire’s blows landed harder.
It felt like Claire had studied martial arts for years!
It was completely unlike him, who had barely learned any self-defense when he was still a child! Right now, he felt like he was facing a profession.
It felt too unfair!
Bam!
Suddenly, a knee to his ribs sent him gasping!
Then, a strike to his shoulder dislocated the joint. But Claire was not stopping any time soon!
Thud! Thud!
Another slam to his leg made him stumble. At this point, his muscles screamed, his bones had already cracked, and his body was battered beyond recognition.
He was helpless!
"Stop! Please, stop!" Terrence cried, with his hoarse voice. His pride was shattered.
He was no longer the confident manipulator who had tried to bend Claire’s will. He seemed just like a broken man, begging for mercy.
But Claire did not relent just yet. She knew what was at stake.
If she allowed him to recover, if she gave him even a second, Pathfinder could cloak him, and he would vanish into the wilderness. She couldn’t risk it!
Finally, when Terrence collapsed to the ground, unable to rise, Claire stepped back.
His body was trembling, his muscles aching, his bones broken...
Without a doubt, he was defeated before he could even reach the full potential of his spell!
"Alright... I guess that’s it." Claire muttered as shereturnedto her body.
She didn’t really feel good about the possession, but it was truly helpful in her case.
Then, without hesitation, she pulled out ropes and bindings from her pack.
She tied his arms and legs tightly, ensuring he couldn’t move.
Then she gagged him, stuffing cloth into his mouth and securing it with another rope.
Even without asking, she could tell that his Hypnotic Suggestion required speech, and she would not give him the chance to use it again.
"Mmmphh... Mmmph..."
Terrence groaned weakly... His eyes were filled with pain and humiliation. He tried to glare at her, but the gag silenced him.
His power was useless now! He couldn’t even negotiate!
It was at this point that Alfie finally moved closer.
He had been frozen in shock, watching the battle unfold.
"Claire..."
His Gladiator instincts had told him to fight, to help Claire, but the truth was undeniable... he hadn’t needed to.
Claire had won the battle alone.
Alfie’s eyes widened as he saw Terrence bound and gagged, lying helpless on the ground.
He realized it had been a one‐sided fight. Terrence, with all his talents and skills, hadn’t stood a chance against Claire, who had powered up using a mysterious ability!
Still, Claire didn’t look that great. When her red eyes faded back to normal as the spirit receded, she felt really weak.
The cost of possession weighed on her since a portion of her permanent health had been consumed... but it was worth it. She would do it again if needed!
"Alfie... I can’t explain all the details, but this guy has Hypnotic Skill or something that can control someone’s mind... and he tried it on me."
Alfie’s eyes widened in realization. He could already imagine what had happened.
"So... Are we going to leave him here?" Alfie asked.
Claire then shook her head and informed him of her next plan.
"He’s dangerous. We’ll take him to Kai. He’ll decide what to do with him."
"Ahh... That sounds better." Alfie nodded silently, still processing what he had witnessed.
Claire had fought like a demon, and Terrence had been crushed without mercy!
Meanwhile, back at Shelter‐45, Kai had just received word through the radio that Claire’s team had successfully located a Gene Trader.
Without hesitation, he began preparing to head toward their position, determined to see the situation for himself.
However, as he and the others advanced through the forest routes, he heard the sound of engines!
It didn’t take long before he spotted them... the new enemy units! They were like Sentinel riders mounted on jet‐like crafts that skimmed through the air like flying jet skis!

chapters.title: Chapter 139: Dragoons!
paragraphs: Kai wasn’t alone as he moved deeper into the forest.
As soon as he got the confirmation that the Gene Trader was found, he took Atom, his loyal Sentinel. He was equipped with both rifle and sword strapped across his back.
Behind them were the rest of the Foreign Survivors... Jonas, Farrah, Ralph, Wallace, Victor, Aurora, Elena, and Marissa.

Together, they formed a formidable group. Their aim was simple... to reach the Gene Trader, spend their extra Survivor Medals, and later trigger its traps to gain more experience by killing more mutants!
Initially, they had planned to use their two armored cars to move quickly, but the dense forest routes forced them to abandon that idea.
The vehicles would be too loud, too bulky, and too easy to spot.
So they advanced on foot instead.
For some time, the forest was quiet, save for the crunch of boots and the occasional rustle of leaves.
But soon, they sensed the presence of flying enemies!
A low hum similar to Swarmers could be heard... However, it was growing louder with each passing second.
"Engines," Kai muttered.
Atom’s sensors also noticed the enemies.
It looked up as it definitely detected the approaching units.
The group then halted as they scanned the treetops...
It didn’t take that long before they saw them, they were small flying vehicles similar to those jet skis! Indeed, they were skimming through the air like those familiar vehicles!.

Each of them carried two Sentinels. One Sentinel had fused its lower body into the vehicle itself, acting as the driver, while the other rode behind with a rifle. Not plasma rifles, but standard ballistic weapons.
Victor cursed under his breath. "So they’ve upgraded again. Flying patrols now."
The riders spotted them almost immediately.
Six crafts broke formation and swooped down!
Twelve Sentinels in total were ready to unleash hell!
"Cover!" Kai shouted.
The group scattered and drew their revolvers!
Bang! Bang! Bang!
Gunfire erupted as the Sentinels opened fire! Soon, bullets tore through branches and soil!
At this point, only Atom dared to step forward!
Its sword still sheathed, but then... It raised its arms to shield the group.
Its advanced armor absorbed the brunt of the shots!
Thud! Thud! Thud!
Atom wasn’t fazed at all! Sparks were just flying as rounds ricocheted harmlessly off its mechanical frame!
With Atom tanking all the attention of the enemies, Kai and others made their move.
Jonas and Farrah fired back with their revolvers, aiming for the riders.
Aurora and Elena crouched low, returning fire even without much accuracy...
Since there are many of them clustered together, they should be able to hit these flying vehicles even by luck!
Everyone wanted to contribute something after all!
They knew that the experience points given by these enemy units were larger than those of the mutants!
Nonetheless, the Sentinels were fast as they moved through the air with a coordinated pattern!
They were shooting at them while moving, and it was hard for Kai’s group to get a hit!
They were at a disadvantage being on the ground!
"Ralph! Wallace!" Kai shouted...
The two men nodded. They were the only ones carrying plasma rifles...
They were rare weapons salvaged from the New Haven Shelter-45. They actually had several more Plasma Rifles, but because they do not have energy cells, they were kinda useless.
Still, they have two Plasma Rifles with energy cells...
Ralph steadied his rifle. With his Sharpshooter Talent, he was the obvious choice for this task.
Wallace, on the other hand, possessed Iron Stamina Talent that was keeping him calm... His Gene Skill, Swift Stride, allowed him to move with incredible speed, closing distances with ease!
Even without the perfect accuracy like Ralph, he could just move closer and guarantee his hit!
At this point, Victor reminded them...
"Careful! Those rifles only have six shots. Make them count."
Ralph exhaled slowly and nodded.
He tracked one of the riders moving through the trees.
Soon, his finger squeezed the trigger.
Fwoosh!
A bolt of plasma tore through the air, striking the driver Sentinel square in the chest!
Thud!
The craft immediately sizzled, and in just the blink of an eye, flames burst from its core before it spiraled out of control and crashed into the ground!
Boom!
While the driver crashed to their death, the Sentinel was thrown away!
[ Enemy Unit Destroyed: Dragoon (C) ]
[ Experience Points distributed among all participants. ]
[ +850 Experience Points ]
"Ohhh! It’s called Dragoons, Kai!" Ralph shouted...
"Yes, I saw the notification!" Kai replied. At this time, he was actually prepared to use his Spirit Pulse... However, it seemed that it was unnecessary.
"Ahh... I also got the first elimination reward! Sorry, Kai! I’ll take the Survivor Medal reward and use it for another transaction with you later!"
"Let’s do that after this!" Kai replied.
Suddenly, Atom was already moving. It was trying to finish off the Sentinel that crashed into the tree!
Whoosh!
With a single throw, Atom’s blade pierced the rider’s head, destroying it instantly!
Another system notification appeared!
"One down!" Ralph shouted.
Wallace grinned, and he moved closer with Swift Stride.
He dashed forward, closing the gap between himself and another craft!

Of course, it wasn’t easy as the Sentinels fired at him! Thankfully, his stamina kept him moving... As soon as he found an opportunity, he jumped up and raised his plasma rifle before he fired at point‐blank range.
Fwoosh!
The bolt obliterated the driver’s head!
Boom!
The craft nosedived, crashing into the forest floor.
Wallace then swung his sword, smashing the second rider before it could recover.
Then, he used his revolver to destroy its already damaged head!
Bang! Bang!
"Two down!" Wallace roared.
The remaining riders regrouped as they circled higher than before!
They realized that fighting closer wouldn’t help them anymore!
Soon, bullets rained down, forcing Kai and the others to duck behind trees.
At this time, Atom had already retrieved its sword and used it to deflect the incoming fire with precise movements.
Meanwhile, Ralph steadied his aim once more. His Sharpshooting Talent allowed him to predict the rider’s path...
Then, he fired.
Fwoosh!
Another craft exploded mid‐air and its debris scattered across the forest.
Boom!
The rider Sentinel’s circuits overloaded, and soon sparks burst from its body before flames consumed it completely!
One by one, the group eliminated the Dragoons!

The bolt obliterated the driver’s head!
Boom!
The craft nosedived, crashing into the forest floor.
Wallace then swung his sword, smashing the second rider before it could recover.
Then, he used his revolver to destroy its already damaged head!
Bang!
Bang!
"Two down!" Wallace roared.
The remaining riders regrouped as they circled higher than before!
They realized that fighting closer wouldn’t help them anymore!
Soon, bullets rained down, forcing Kai and the others to duck behind trees.
At this time, Atom had already retrieved its sword and used it to deflect the incoming fire with precise movements.
Meanwhile, Ralph steadied his aim once more.
His Sharpshooting Talent allowed him to predict the rider’s path...
Then, he fired.
Fwoosh!
Another craft exploded mid‐air and its debris scattered across the forest.
Boom!
The rider Sentinel’s circuits overloaded, and soon sparks burst from its body before flames consumed it completely!
One by one, the group eliminated the Dragoons!

chapters.title: Chapter 140: Very Serious Matter
paragraphs: Wallace sprinted again with his Swift Stride...
Then, he leapt onto a branch, using it as leverage to propel himself closer to another flying vehicle!
"Haha! Got yah!"
Just like that, he fired his plasma rifle, and the light passed through the driver’s fused torso!
Boom!
After destroying the driver, the craft spun wildly before crashing.
Someone below then finished the second rider with their thrown hatchets and gunshots.
"Four down!" Victor shouted, keeping count.
But the Sentinels weren’t finished. Two more Dragoons were left!
They circled higher, trying to find an opening.
Thankfully, they weren’t planning to retreat at all!
"It’ll be our chance soon..." Kai muttered as he watched the two Dragoons firing nonstop, forcing his group to stay pinned.
Kai gritted his teeth. "We need to finish this."
Ralph nodded as he held his Plasma Rifle tightly...
Then, he lined up his shot, and as soon as he saw the vehicle swoop low, trying to flank them, Ralph fired.
Fwoosh!
The plasma bolt pierced the craft’s engine!
Boom!
It exploded in a burst, sending both Sentinels crashing to the ground.
At this point, Atom moved in swiftly, retrieving its sword and slicing through the wreckage, ensuring both enemies were destroyed.
[ Enemy Unit Destroyed: Dragoon (C) ]
[ Experience Points distributed among all participants. ]
[ +850 Experience Points ]
"One left!" Kai shouted. He really didn’t expect that he wouldn’t even need to use his Gene Skills!

’These guys are awesome... As long as they have those Plasma Rifles and enough food. I can entrust the shelter to them without any worries.’Kai thought as he was considering that he might have to visit the human city that he had seen on the map before.
He was really curious why it was not being attacked by A.I. Aria, or the Anima Civilization.
"Finish that thing!" Kai ordered as he saw Wallace move.
Right now, he felt a surge of satisfaction. Feeding and training these capable people was paying off. His efforts to help them grow were no longer wasted... they were proving their worth in battle.
At this point, Wallace dashed forward as he dodged through gunfire while closing the distance. The final Dragoon tried to ascend, but Wallace was already beneath it with a powerful jump!
Just like that, he fired his last plasma shot directly into the driver’s head.
Fwoosh!
Boom!
Then, the flying vehicle erupted, and it crashed violently!
Wallace leapt aside, rolling to safety as debris scattered.
"Ohhh... That was close." Wallace muttered.
Meanwhile, the rider Sentinel was still able to move as it grabbed the rifle from the wreckage...
But Atom was faster. The Sentinel waved its sword once more!
Thud!
The blade embedded itself into the Sentinel’s head.
Sparks appeared everywhere before the machine collapsed lifelessly.
Silence fell over the forest. Smoke rose from the wreckage of six destroyed crafts. Twelve Sentinels lay broken, their bodies scattered across the ground.
The group lowered their weapons as they rested for some time. It was a really dangerous battle! Thankfully, they also have those Plasma Rifles!
And it would increase even more!
"Ohhh! We won! Atom! You’re the best!"
"Those Dragoons! They’re definitely strong but they chose the wrong opponent!"
"Whoohoo! Let’s loot them, hurry!"
"Their cores weren’t badly damaged. This is amazing!"
Ralph checked his plasma rifle... empty. Wallace’s was drained as well. They had used their shots wisely, each one decisive.
Victor nodded approvingly. "I have two more energy cells here... Let’s replace them."
He then turned to Marissa and the others.
"As for you guys, just take the ordinary rifles they brought!
Apparently, the rider Sentinels didn’t bring Plasma Rifles, just the normal ones."
Kai exhaled as he watched the others loot them.
"Good work, everyone. Atom, retrieve your sword."
The Sentinel obeyed, pulling its blade free from the wreckage.
Jonas also wiped sweat from his brow. "That was too close. If not for Ralph and Wallace, we’d have been shredded."
Farrah nodded. "And Atom. Without its defense, we wouldn’t have survived the first volley."
Aurora then glanced at Kai. "What now?"
Kai looked toward the forest path. "We keep moving. Claire’s team is ahead. We need to reach them before more Riders show up."
The group gathered itself, reloading their revolvers, checking their gear. The forest was littered with wreckage, but they had survived.
Together, Kai, Atom, and the rest of the Foreign Survivors pressed forward!
Kai and his team pressed through the forest as they finished looting the Dragoons.
Now, they felt more confident going outside!
The other Foreign Survivors followed close, with their revolvers reloaded...

When they finally reached the clearing that Claire established as their temporary base, Kai expected to see the Gene Trader waiting, perhaps surrounded by its strange wares. But what caught his eye wasn’t the trader at all.
"Huh?"
At this time, his gaze locked onto a man bound tightly with ropes, gagged, and surrounded by Claire’s team.
Kai’s eyes squinted. "Wait... that’s Terrence."
The others murmured in surprise, recognizing the man as well. Terrence looked battered, his body trembling, his eyes filled with humiliation... Something really big had happened.
He tried to glare at them, but the gag silenced him completely.
Kai stepped forward and looked at both Alfie and Claire...
"Hey... what did he do?"
Claire turned to him...
She didn’t waste time explaining everything in detail. Instead, she gestured toward Terrence. "Do you have that Status Crystal? Use it to reveal his skills. It’s important."

Kai blinked, realizing the weight of her words. She wanted him to be the one to uncover the truth. Whatever Terrence had done, it wasn’t just a simple betrayal... Perhaps it was something dangerous, something that could threaten the entire shelter.
He couldn’t ignore this...
"Very well. Wait a moment." Kai replied.
Claire’s tone had really changed. "I want you to see it for yourself. His Skill isn’t something we can ignore."
The Foreign Survivors exchanged glances. Jonas muttered, "So that’s why he’s tied up like a criminal..."
Farrah frowned. "If Claire went this far, it must be serious."

chapters.title: Chapter 141: Terrence’s Skills
paragraphs: Kai had decided to use one of his precious Inventory Slots for the Status Crystal since it was an expensive item. It could only be obtained by purchasing from the Gene Trader using Survivor Medals.
"I got it..." Kai said as he pulled out the Status Crystal.
He had only used them on locals, but he had never tried them with Claire and the other Foreign Survivors.

After all, it only had 50 charges, and after using it about 40 times, he didn’t have enough left. He could recharge it by spending Spirit Points, but he wasn’t sure how many Spirit Points would be needed for a single charge. That would only be known once it was completely empty.
He held it up, stepping closer to Terrence.
The bound man squirmed... His eyes widened as he realized what was about to happen.
Oommpphhh!
He didn’t want to have his Skill revealed!
He tried to shake his head, but only muffled sounds escaped from behind the gag. But soon, it touched his forehead!

"Let’s see what you’ve been hiding." Kai muttered as he was really confused about this situation. He didn’t really see Terrence as a perverted man. The man even saved Jonas and Aurora and brought them into his shelter, earning him a title that was like a Savior...
However, seeing how Claire looked really serious, it seemed that Terrence had hidden himself really well.
Soon, the crystal pulsed, and one charge was used up...
Light spilled across Terrence’s body. Then, lines of text began to form in the air, similar to their Apocalypse System.
Claire folded her arms, watching intently while Alfie stood nearby, still shaken from earlier, but his eyes were locked on the display.
Kai’s team leaned in, waiting for the revelation.
Soon, the truth was about to be exposed.
[ Name: Terrence ]
[ Title: Survivor, Rescuer ]
[ Level: 12 ]
[ Spirit: 20 / 156 ]
[ Physique Rating: D ]
[ Talent: Pathfinder (Epic) ]
[ Active Skills: Trail Mark (Lv3) ]
[ Passive Skills: Hypnotic Suggestion (Lv5), Danger Sense (Lv2) ]
[ Skill Points: 0 ]
Kai’s eyes widened. "Hypnotic Suggestion... Level 5."
The others froze as they saw the man’s set of abilities.
"That explains everything..." Jonas muttered.

Farrah also clenched her fists as she realized what had happened. "No wonder Claire tied him up. He probably tried it on someone and got caught by Claire. That’s a dangerous ability within the shelter."

Aurora’s face paled. "Just how strong is this ability? Maybe if he spoke even a few words, we might’ve obeyed without realizing it... But this skill isn’t meant to be used against A.I. Army... What’s the system thinking? Why make a Gene Skill aimed at humans? Aren’t we supposed to be helping each other?"

Victor shook his head. "And with Pathfinder combined with Danger Sense... he’s basically impossible to ambush. He can sense threats and escape routes. I wonder how Claire managed to catch him... Claire, do you have a counter against his skill? You’re awesome."
Claire smiled as she heard this.
"Something like that. Don’t worry. If we encounter any mind controllers or those with similar Skills and Talent, I’ll take care of them!"
The moment she said it, everyone froze in shock. It was a statement you couldn’t help but trust.
If a beam of light had fallen on her, then she would’ve looked like an angel.
Kai also understood their concern.

He still recalled the man who had a stronger talent that could turn other humans into puppets or maybe slaves. He then used other Survivors like expendables to attack their shelter before. That man even controlled Samantha, leading to her death.
Nonetheless, he didn’t need Claire’s explanation anymore.
The truth was clear even if she remained silent.
Terrence had hidden a dangerous ability that could compromise the entire shelter, and he must have used it on someone within Assault Team B. That’s not easily forgiven.

However, Kai couldn’t really recommend dealth penalty if this was only a preemptive strike to avoid any troubles in the future. That felt a bit too much, considering no one seemed to be injured except for him.

But still, Wallace spat on the ground. "We should torture him. Make him spill everything he had done before without our knowledge! Maybe he already used it on us, and we just didn’t know! A guy like this doesn’t deserve mercy."
Kai doubted that Terrence had used it before since it would’ve been noticed by Claire, but he didn’t speak and just observed the man’s reaction.
As expected, he looked horrified. His eyes were pleading as if he was saying that he had been wronged!
Ralph then shook his head. "Or use him as bait. Tie him up, throw him out when Sentinels come, and let them chase him instead of us."
Marissa frowned. "That’s cruel... but he’s dangerous. If he uses this skill, he could turn us against each other."
Jonas added, "We could exile him. Send him out with no weapons, no food. If he survives, fine. If not, it’s his fault."
Well, Terrence had still rescued him and Aurora from Haven-15. He didn’t really want Terrence to die here. If he were exiled, he would still have a chance of survival.
The group’s voices overlapped as they provided their suggestions on what to do with him.
Terrence squirmed, and without a doubt, his muffled cries were desperate.
Finally, he managed to push against the gag enough to make himself heard.
"Mmmphhh! Please! Don’t kill me!"
Claire removed the gag just enough for him to speak.
Terrence gasped as he continued... "Listen! I swear I won’t use it again! Please, forgive me! If you want, imprison me... exile me... anything! Just don’t kill me!"
He looked at Kai directly, his eyes filled with desperation.

"I have family back on Earth. A wife... children... I only wanted to survive here. I didn’t mean to hurt anyone. I’ll accept punishment, but please... don’t end me like this. Right! I have some items with me in my Inventory! You can have all of them!"
The Foreign Survivors exchanged uneasy glances. His words made him really pitiful...
Furthermore, it seemed that Claire had actually stopped him in time before committing something unforgivable. Still, the danger of his Skill was undeniable.
Kai remained silent for a moment...
Would he allow someone with Hypnosis Ability to stay in his shelter?
Everyone waited for his decision.

chapters.title: Chapter 142: The Wink and the Hidden Talent
paragraphs: Kai could feel the tension in the group...
Half of them wanted Terrence gone, afraid that they might be controlled unknowingly.
Still, the other half hesitated and left the final decision to him.
Claire also finished listening and turned to Kai... It was time to speak.
"You all saw it. Hypnotic Suggestion. He tried using it on me, but he didn’t know about my Talent, so I got lucky... The others will not. If he’s allowed to speak freely, he can bend others’ will."
The others only knew about Claire’s physical strengtheningtalent. However, Kai and the three others from Haven-45 knew about Claire’s spirit, whom they suspected was Greed.

"That’s why I gagged him for now. I’m not sure about the limitation of his Skill, but since we saw it’s a Level 5 Skill, it’s safe to assume it’s a very strong Skill that could affect multiple people at once. He’s not harmless."
She paused for a moment before she shared what she wanted to happen. "We should just confine him for now..."
Alfie nodded. "Confining him is a good choice. However, I will also vote to send this person away. He’ll not survive anyway."
Victor then looked at Kai and asked, "So what do we do? Kill him? Lock him up? Use him?"
Kai sighed as he looked at Terrence.

He actually believed that Terrence’s Pathfinder Talent would greatly help their shelter’s future. However, the fact that he tried to be mischievous and used hypnotic suggestion on Claire was quite terrifying.
Terrence wasn’t even denying it.
After a few moments, he finally spoke. He already heard enough.
"Alright. We can’t ignore his Skill. Hypnotic Suggestion is too worrying. But killing him outright... that’s not the answer."
Terrence fell to his knees, trembling at the thought of dying. "I’ll accept exile. I’ll leave the shelter. Just let me live. Please."
The group fell silent, waiting for Kai’s decision.

"Imprisoning him won’t work," he said firmly. "With his Gene Enhancement, handcuffs and simple restraints won’t hold him. And keeping a prisoner consumes food we can’t afford to waste... It will add to someone’s work as well... and if we won’t feed him, then we might as well kill him now."
The group stiffened at his blunt words.

"But again, killing him outright seems too harsh," Kai continued. "He hasn’t destroyed us yet. He hasn’t killed anyone... He even saved some of us with his skills. This is also his first offense... probably. So instead... he’ll buy his life, and we’ll put a restraint on him."
Terrence’s head turned as he looked at Kai, grateful at his mercy.
Kai then continued.
"Empty your Inventory... Every resource, every Survivor Medal... and that Arm Replacement Implant you purchased but haven’t used yet... It’s ours now. That’s the price for your survival."
Terrence trembled, but he nodded frantically. "Yes... yes! I’ll give it all! Just don’t kill me!"
Just like that, Terrence gave up all his belongings...
Still, Kai wasn’t finished yet.
"Sending him out might lead to trouble later. He could join another group, or worse, use his Skill against us once he got stronger."
Terrence shook his head violently.
"No! I swear I won’t cause issues! I’ll never use Hypnotic Suggestion again. I’ll accept exile if you want. Please... I’ll do anything!"
The group exchanged uneasy glances. Terrence looked pitiful, but Kai was right. He might return someday.
However, Kai just smiled and turned to someone else... not to Claire, not to Victor, but to Marissa!
"Marissa," Kai said.
Everyone blinked in confusion.
"Marissa? Why her?"
This was everyone’s thought.
Most of them thought she was just an unimportant Survivor.
She was part of the Support Division, and she would normally help with Irene in the medical bay and would rarely help in battles against the A.I. Army...
They believed that she was someone without notable Talent or Gene Skills.
But Kai, as leader, had made it his duty to learn everyone’s abilities. He would even reward them with a Gift Pack, so they don’t feel bad sharing their Talents and Skills with him.
Because of that, he knew the truth about her skills!
Marissa’s eyes widened as Kai looked at her.
She hesitated only for a moment before she nodded.
Kai explained, "Her Talent... isn’t meant for fighting the A.I. Army. But right now, it’s exactly what we need."
The group waited, curious about her abilities.
Of course, Kai didn’t reveal it...
"Hey, can I at least know the name of her Talent? Or if not, will you explain how it works?" Claire asked.
"Well, I can’t explain the full details, but I guess revealing the name of her Talent isn’t a problem... It’s called Witch Doctor... as for what it does, we can leave it to your imagination."
"Witch Doctor?!"
It wasn’t just Terrence who was shocked. Everyone looked at Marissa with wide eyes. They didn’t expect this sudden revelation.
They really thought that she was just an unimportant Foreign Survivor who was helping in the infirmary!
"A witch doctor? What does that even mean?" Victor whispered to himself.
He wasn’t asking Kai about it. He knew that Kai wouldn’t reveal it in front of Terrence. He was simply unable to comprehend how it would be useful now...
’Ahh... Is it--’
The moment he realized what it meant, Kai already gave his instructions. "Alright... Marissa. Put the curse on him."
Terrence’s face went pale as he heard this.
Soon, Marissa stepped forward and placed her hand on Terrence’s shoulder. Then, she activated her Gene Skill!
In just a moment, a pale purple light appeared and seeped into Terrence’s body!
It wasn’t painful or caused any discomfort. However, Terrence trembled, convinced something unnatural was happening.
Kai watched silently and nodded.
"It’s done. You’re cursed now. If you ever come back to cause trouble, Marissa will know. And activate the curse in your heart..."
Terrence’s lips quivered. "I’ll never return to harm you. I’ll live quietly. I’ll change. I’ll become a better person!"
Kai nodded. "This is your second life, Terrence. Don’t waste it."
The group exchanged glances... They had varying thoughts about this decision from Kai.
However, this was also something that they liked about Kai. Even with the A.I. Apocalypse and so many deaths witnessed during this time, Kai still knew the value of human lives.
"Hmph. Better hope that curse works." Wallace muttered...
At this time, however, none of them noticed how Marissa winked at Kai before going to the Gene Trader’s treehouse.

Still, the other half hesitated and left the final decision to him.

"You all saw it.
Hypnotic Suggestion.
He tried using it on me, but he didn’t know about my Talent, so I got lucky...
The others will not.
If he’s allowed to speak freely, he can bend others’ will."

He already heard enough.

Terrence fell to his knees, trembling at the thought of dying.
"I’ll accept exile.

Just let me live.
Please."

"Imprisoning him won’t work," he said firmly.

It will add to someone’s work as well... and if we won’t feed him, then we might as well kill him now."
The group stiffened at his blunt words.

"He hasn’t destroyed us yet.
He hasn’t killed anyone...

"Empty your Inventory...
Every resource, every Survivor Medal... and that Arm Replacement Implant you purchased but haven’t used yet...
It’s ours now.
That’s the price for your survival."
Terrence trembled, but he nodded frantically.

I’ll give it all!
Just don’t kill me!"
Just like that, Terrence gave up all his belongings...
Still, Kai wasn’t finished yet.

Terrence shook his head violently.

I swear I won’t cause issues!
I’ll never use Hypnotic Suggestion again.
I’ll accept exile if you want.
Please...
I’ll do anything!"

chapters.title: Chapter 144: The Floating Thing
paragraphs: A few moments ago, Kai and the others were busy stopping the frantic advance of the mutants...

As soon as they killed dozens of them, these mutants started pressing harder. It was as if they were blinded by rage after seeing their fellow mutants die without even being able to touch their targets.
Thankfully, Kai had prepared their traps really well.
While Atom remained free to support whichever side was weaker, Kai decided to go in front in case there was a need to use his Spirit Pulse to help his friends.
With his Specter Step, he was able to move around faster and kill more mutants after all.
He swiftly cut down any mutant that had slipped past the traps!
"Atom! Don’t hold back anymore! Kill as many as you can!" Kai shouted as the battle raged on. Mutants kept coming, crawling from every direction, their numbers seemingly endless.
The survivors fought really hard with their blades while Ralph and a few others relied on their revolvers... They had to be faster reloading them, but it was perfectly fine.
Whoosh~
Aurora ducked as a mutant swung at her, then drove her dagger into its throat.
"Careful!"
Jonas pulled her back just in time as another mutant jumped forward, only to be impaled on a metal pike.
Victor, on the other hand, roared as he swung his axe, splitting a mutant’s skull. "That’s another one!"
Marissa, though not a frontline fighter, moved quickly to support, dragging wounded survivors back and throwing her hatchets in hopes of ending their enemies’ lives.
Kai’s voice rang out again. "Hold steady! Don’t break formation!"
The survivors obeyed...
The traps continued to do their work, thinning the horde.
Pitfalls filled with writhing bodies, trip wires sent mutants sprawling, and the barricades held firm.
Still, the pressure was immense.
Sweat poured down their faces, as more and more mutants kept coming...
But the promise of Experience Points kept them going. Every kill meant growth, strength, survival.
However, as more mutants started appearing everywhere, they heard a buzzing sound in the air!
The survivors froze as they scanned the treetops, expecting the Dragoons or Swarmers...
However, the buzzing grew louder, rattling through the air like a swarm of monstrous insects.
Then, the shadows parted.
It wasn’t a swarm at all.
"Above us!" Kai shouted in shock.
A massive flying fortress drifted overhead...
Its engines were humming like thunder; it was blotting out the sky!
The sheer size of it made the ground tremble, and for a moment, the Mutants themselves seemed confused... Their shrieks even grew louder as they glanced upward!
The survivors felt dazed as they realized what was happening!
Wallace’s revolver almost slipped from his sweaty hands while Jonas nearly dropped his spear.
"W-what the hell is that thing?!"
"Are we about to be obliterated?"
"This is crazy... So unfair!"
"Wait... What’s that smell?"
Someone actually pissed their pants. The stench mixed horribly with the smell of gunpowder and mutant blood.
Aurora grimaced, but she couldn’t help laughing nervously. "Seriously? Right now?"
But there was no time to dwell on embarrassment. The Mutants were still charging, and the traps were still snapping shut.
Kai shouted...
"Focus! Don’t just stare at it! Kill the Mutants!"
The survivors snapped back to reality as they wielded their weapons once again.
Even those with soiled pants had to fight... Well, their faces were red with shame, but they swung their weapons.
Still, the fortress lingered in their minds. Its silhouette was unlike anything they had ever seen! It was a floating city of steel drifting silently across the sky.
Claire’s voice trembled as she sliced through a mutant’s throat.
"Are we really sent to the A.I. Rebellion Apocalypse? That thing we saw... it looked like something meant for Alien Invasion Apocalypse!"

Jonas stabbed a mutant through the chest while panting heavily. "Ah... I just remembered. I had three choices when I was thrown into this mess. I chose A.I. Rebellion over Alien Invasion and Zombie Outbreak. Now I’m starting to regret it..."
Victor grunted as he split another mutant’s skull. "If that fortress belongs to the A.I. Army, then we’re screwed. If it belongs to aliens, we’re double screwed."
Marissa, still catching her breath, muttered, "Maybe it’s just passing by. Maybe it didn’t even notice us."
Kai’s eyes squinted as he cut down another mutant. "Doesn’t matter. Whether it’s A.I. or alien, we’ll deal with it when the time comes. For now, finish the fight!"
The survivors roared in agreement. With this yell, their fear turned into adrenaline.
Just like that, they hacked, stabbed, and shot until the last of the mutants fell with their bodies piling against the barricades.
"We won!"
"I leveled up!"
"Wohooo! Me too! Check the Leaderboard!"
"I don’t care about the Leaderboard! Let’s hide now, please!"
"My blade’s chipped, but who cares? I still got five kills! I want more."
"Ugh, my pants are ruined... don’t laugh, I panicked when that fortress showed up!"
"Did anyone see that mutant I sliced? Clean cut, I swear!"
"Stop bragging, idiots! We’re all covered in blood and stink..."
"Thank you, Kai! Let’s run this again one more time?"
"No! Not yet! That flying city is still above us."
Soon, they all looked back at the huge flying vessel.
After a few minutes, this vessel was already fading into the distance. It didn’t bother them at all!
Just like that, silence fell over the battlefield with the survivors standing among the corpses of the mutants.
"Hahaha! It’s done..."
Wallace broke the silence with a nervous laugh.
"Well... at least the flying fortress didn’t shoot us. That’s... something, right?"
Aurora shook her head. "Something? That thing looked like it could wipe out a city in seconds."
"If that fortress really belongs to the A.I. Army, then that’s definitely from Anima Civilization instead of A.I. Aria, the rebel," Claire muttered. "This is important information."
Then, as the flying fortress left without even bothering them, everyone heaved a sigh of relief. It seemed that it didn’t care about weaklings at all.
’Wait... that direction.’ Kai was stunned as he recalled the map he had.
If he wasn’t mistaken, that flying fortress was heading in the direction leading to one of the few remaining Human Cities!

chapters.title: Chapter 145: The Ranking and the Level Up Rewards
paragraphs: Kai had almost memorized the complete map of the Mavis Republic, especially the Haven Region where they are located.
Furthermore, over the past few days, Kai was able to understand the map and found the exact location of their shelter based on the landmarks he found.
He was aware that there were four large A.I. Cities in this region and one Human City. He had even doubted that information and believed that it was already ruined by now.
After all, he had seen the A.I. Army’s Ascendant Units that were capable of fighting against multiple highly Augmented Humans before.
However, there was still some hope in his heart, believing that the Human City was still standing strong against the mechanized army of the A.I. Civilization.
If possible, he really wanted to visit that place, and perhaps, they’d be able to move there or, at the very least, obtain powerful Gene Skills that they could use against the A.I. Army.
’That flying fortress... It might be heading to the Human City. I hope you can repel that thing.’Kai thought to himself as he turned his attention back to everyone...
"Hey, Kai! Look at the leaderboard! Almost all of us are in the Top 20! Isn’t that amazing?!" Claire suddenly said.
Apparently, as soon as the flying fortress disappeared, Claire immediately checked the Leaderboard.
"Alright... Let me check..." Kai said as he opened the feature.
[ Top Survivor Ranking List ]
[ 1. Kai - Level 27 ]
[ 2. Renji - Level 16 ]
[ 3. Mei - Level 15 ]
[ 4. Claire - Level 15 ]
[ 5. Ralph - Level 14 ]
[ 6. Victor - Level 14 ]
[ 7. Cynthia - Level 13 ]
[ 8. Roderick - Level 13 ]
[ 9. Lena - Level 13 ]
[ 10. Kevin - Level 13 ]
[ 20. Aurora - 13 ]
Kai studied the list quietly, and as expected, thanks to Atom, who was always last hitting the enemies, he was able to maintain his ranking.
Without Atom, he’d probably not even reach Level 20 at this early stage of the Apocalypse.
Claire, on the other hand, couldn’t hide her excitement.
"See? Even Aurora managed to enter the list!"
She clapped her hands together before she continued.

"Look, look... Fourth place! Just a bit more. Once I enter the Top 3 before the end of the month, then I’ll also get the Special Reward! I didn’t think I’d be ranked that high... I mean, I knew I was strong, but seeing it written there makes it feel real!"
Farrah and Alfie, on the other hand, couldn’t help but feel a little jealous after seeing the Leaderboard.
After all, even Victor, a Mechanic, had reached the Top 6.
Still, they knew Victor had enjoyed a similar farming experience with Kai’s team, unlike them, who were still quite new to this raiding pattern.

As for Ralph, he found his ranking a bit concerning. He also wanted to reach the Top 3 after all. "Top Five, huh? It’s not that bad, but I can do better. Guess all those headshots finally counted for something."
"Are you not satisfied?" Wallace asked.
"Hmmm? Well... I’m not fully satisfied. But I’ll climb higher. Just wait."
Victor, on the other hand, was already satisfied with his ranking...
He really had to thank Kai for this opportunity. After all, without this type of mutant farming, he’d just be staying in his workshop, and his Leveling would just halt in the process.

"I didn’t expect to be up there. I mean, I’m just a mechanic. Seeing my name among the top survivors feels... weird." He chuckled awkwardly, then added, "But hey, I’ll take it... I hope I also get a nice Gene Skill after reaching Level 15."
Claire nudged him playfully. "Weird? You should be proud! You’re practically famous now. Everyone can see your name."
Victor groaned. "I just hope we won’t get hunted by others for experience points. It’s a good thing it was only showing our first names."
Just like that, the group couldn’t help but start a small celebration for their achievement.
Even though the rankings were just numbers, seeing their names displayed so prominently gave them a strange mix of pride, embarrassment, and determination to hold on to this ranking.
Soon, those who leveled up focus on the notifications they received from the system.
This time, Claire finally checked the long notifications she had received.

"Wow... Kai. So this is what you told us before. I now have Reputation Points! Just like what you said. Only Level 15 and above can have them..." Claire said as she started checking her notifications.
Kai nodded.

"Yes... But it’s a bit difficult getting them. As far as I know, you can only get them from the first kill of C-Grade enemy units or higher, or some other achievements. Well, maybe killing B-Grade enemy units will grant us better, but let’s not think about hunting them just yet."
For now, he wasn’t really worried about the number of Reputation Points that he had. After all, he still had no idea how to use them or if being popular really had a value.
Perhaps getting higher Rep Points might even attract the attention of the A.I. Army.
For now, Kai confirmed the notification of his latest level-up.
[ You have leveled up! ]
[ Level: 27 ]
[ Health Points +5 ]
[ Spirit Points +1 ]
[ Physique Rating Improved: C- ]
[ Inventory Slots Expanded: +1 ]
[ You have received an Instant Experience Potion x1 ]
"A free exp potion?" Kai muttered.
It was tempting to drink it right away, but Kai chose to save it for later.
Instead, he turned to the group. "Burn the mutant corpses. Rest, eat, and recover. We’ll run the trap again once everyone’s ready."
The survivors cheered weakly, exhausted but thrilled with their activity...
Despite the blood and sweat, they had suffered only injuries... no casualties.
That made them confident to have another run.
"This is great... Another round. Let’s continue this until the Gene Trader leaves!" Claire shouted in celebration.
If possible, she wanted to reach Level 20 today!
"Experience Points farming for the win! If we keep this up, I’ll hit Top 3 for sure!"
